This role is responsible for creating accurate 3D models, producing detailed shop drawings, and developing manufacturing-ready documentation to support production.

Create and modify 3D models and assemblies using SolidWorks.

Develop production-ready designs using SWOOD (Design, CAM, or Manufacturing modules).

Produce detailed shop drawings, fabrication drawings, cut lists, and assembly documentation.

Interpret architectural drawings, specifications, and project requirements.

Collaborate with engineering, production, and project management teams to ensure designs are accurate and manufacturable.

Review and refine designs to meet quality standards and manufacturing best practices.

Support CNC programming and manufacturing workflows where applicable.

Maintain organized project files, revisions, and technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

Proficiency in SolidWorks.

Experience using SWOOD (Design, CAM, or Manufacturing modules).

Experience in millwork, casework, or architectural woodworking.

Strong ability to read, interpret, and produce detailed shop drawings.

Knowledge of woodworking materials, joinery, hardware, and manufacturing processes.

Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and collaboration abilities.



Key Competencies

Millwork detailing

Technical drafting and shop drawings

3D modeling using SolidWorks

SWOOD design and manufacturing workflows

Manufacturing-focused problem solving

Cross-functional collaboration

description:
About Us

We are a growing public accounting firm looking for a detail-oriented, reliable, and highly qualified Certified Public Accountant (CPA) based in the Philippines to assist our team with external audit engagements, assurance work, and bookkeeping tasks.



The Role

This is a remote position where you will perform jobs that include both accounting and audit preparation. You will handle substantive audit testing, workpaper documentation, alongside routine bookkeeping tasks for accounting.



Key Responsibilities

Audit & Assurance: Prepare structured, fully-referenced audit workpapers in accordance with relevant auditing standards. Conduct analytical procedures and substantive testing on key financial statement accounts (Cash, AR, Revenue, Inventory, etc.).

Audit Evidence & Documentation: Review client documentation (invoices, receipts, bank statements) for accuracy, completeness, and proper accounting treatment.

Full-Cycle Bookkeeping: Perform day-to-day transaction recording, general ledger maintenance, month-end closes, bank reconciliations, and trial balance mapping.

Discrepancy Identification: Identify bookkeeping errors, missing documentation, or control risks, and report findings directly to the engagement manager.



Required Qualifications

Credential: Active CPA License (PRC or international equivalent).

Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience combining external audit work (Big 4 or mid-tier firm background preferred) and hands-on bookkeeping/accounting.

Tech Stack: Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online, Xero) and audit tools. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Index/Match) are mandatory.

Communication: Written and verbal English skills to collaborate smoothly with the offshore team.



Compensation & Work Logistics

Monthly Compensation: $950 USD / month 

Schedule & Hours: Full-Time 40 hours per week).

Timezone Overlap: Must be willing to work with an overlap with EST business hours for daily check-ins and huddles.

Location: (100% Remote).

Probation - 6 Months

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Commercial Services
description:
C&S Handyman Service LLC is looking for an experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to help us acquire new commercial customers in the United States.



We are a commercial and residential maintenance company based in New Jersey. We provide services including facility maintenance, handyman work, junk removal, carpentry, drywall, painting, flooring, repairs, cleanouts, and other property maintenance services.



Your primary responsibility will be calling businesses and introducing our company to the person responsible for maintenance, facilities, or property operations.



Examples of businesses we may target include:



Self-storage facilities

Property management companies

Retail stores

Restaurants

Offices

Warehouses

Apartment/property managers

Small and medium-sized businesses

Commercial property owners



You will be provided with a calling script and guidance on what services we are trying to sell.



Your goal is not necessarily to close the customer on the phone. Your goal is to identify the correct decision-maker, introduce C&S Handyman Service, determine whether they use outside maintenance contractors, and generate a qualified opportunity or appointment for our management team.



Responsibilities include:



Making outbound B2B cold calls to businesses in our target areas

Following our provided sales script

Asking for the facility manager, property manager, general manager, owner, or other decision-maker

Introducing our commercial maintenance services

Identifying businesses that need contractors for ongoing or one-time work

Scheduling calls or estimates with interested prospects

Following up with prospects when necessary

Recording call results and notes accurately

Maintaining an organized prospect list

Sending a daily report of calls, conversations, appointments, and follow-ups



Requirements:



Excellent spoken English

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

Professional and confident phone presence

Previous cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or B2B sales experience

Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment

Able to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Organized and able to track follow-ups

Comfortable handling rejection and continuing to call



Experience selling services to U.S. businesses, contractors, property managers, facility managers, or commercial businesses is a major plus.



When applying, please include:



Your previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

What industries you have called.

Approximately how many outbound calls you have made per day in previous roles.

A short voice recording introducing yourself as if you were calling a potential C&S Handyman Service customer.

Your hourly rate.

Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team if they perform well.

title: Appliance Repair Office Administrator / Dispatcher
description:
Fast Appliance Repair LTD is looking for a reliable, organized, and customer-focused Full-Time Office Administrator / Dispatcher to join our growing appliance repair company.



This is an important role in our day-to-day operations. You will be the main point of contact for customers, technicians, and warranty companies, helping ensure that service calls are scheduled, communicated, and completed smoothly.

s

title: Senior In-Market Qualitative Research Consultant (Food & Beverage / Trade Sector)
description:
LOCATION: Metro Manila

CONTRACT TYPE: Short-Term Independent Consultancy (Flexible)



PROJECT DURATION: 6–8 Weeks



ABOUT THE ROLE:

INSIGLOBEX LLC, a U.S.-based trade research firm executing a federally funded market assessment for U.S. agricultural exports, is seeking an experienced, senior qualitative researcher to lead on-the-ground stakeholder interviews in the beverage alcohol and hospitality sector.



The Consultant will identify, schedule, conduct, and summarize 12 to 15 high-level Key Stakeholder Interviews  with major industry gatekeepers, including primary alcohol importers, hotel/resort F&B directors, speakeasy managers, and trade association leaders.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (IN-SCOPE):

• Sampling Plan Development: Identify and build an approved contact list of 15+ target interviewees across the local beverage ecosystem.

• Stakeholder Outreach & Scheduling: Coordinate and confirm in-person or virtual interviews with key decision-makers.

• Interview Execution: Conduct 12 to 15 structured 30–45 minute interviews in English (or local language translated into English) following provided qualitative interview guides.

• Compliance Protocol: Secure signed/recorded informed consent from 100% of participants prior to interview recording.

• Briefing Summaries: Complete a standardized, 1-to-2 page Key Stakeholder Interview  Summary in English for every finished interview.

• Time & Travel Tracking: Submit daily activity timesheets and receipts.



EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE:

This role is strictly focused on high-level qualitative interviews. 



QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:

• Proven Experience: 5+ years in qualitative research, trade policy analysis, market access, or consultancy in the Food & Beverage / Hospitality sector.

• Industry Network: Strong professional network or proven ability to access executive-level gatekeepers (importers, hotel F&B directors, customs brokers).

• Language Skills: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. Local language capability (Tagalog) is highly preferred.

• Technical Capabilities: Reliable smartphone/recorder for audio capture and access to Microsoft Word/Excel.

• Professionalism: Strict adherence to data ethics, confidentiality, and anti-bribery/federal grant standards.



COMPENSATION & TIME COMMITMENT:

title: Creative Instagram Reels Editor for Fitness, Biomechanics and Neurology Content
description:
Hi,



I’m looking for a creative short-form video editor to help me produce high-quality Instagram Reels on an ongoing basis.



I’m a coach specialising in neurology, biomechanics and strength training. My content combines education, practical demonstrations, client reactions, humour and before-and-after movement changes.



I will provide the raw footage, the main content idea and general direction. Your job will be to turn it into a clean, engaging Reel that holds attention without looking over-edited or generic.



What I need:



• Strong pacing and clean cuts

• Accurate, easy-to-read captions

• Purposeful zooms, sound effects and transitions

• Supporting B-roll, graphics or images when they help explain the topic

• Good understanding of hooks and viewer retention

• Basic colour correction and audio improvement

• Ability to match my personality and brand style

• Vertical 1080 × 1920 export ready for Instagram

• Good spoken and written English

• Reliable communication and turnaround times



The editing should feel energetic, clever and professional. I don’t want excessive animations, random effects or the typical over-edited “online guru” style. My personality, the information and the client reactions should remain the focus.



I’m initially looking for approximately 6-10 Reels per month, with the possibility of increasing this if we work well together.



To apply, please send:



1. Three examples of your best short-form edits. Please only include work you personally edited.

2. Your price per Reel and your preferred monthly rate for 6-10 Reels.

3. Your usual turnaround time.

4. What editing software you use.

5. A short explanation of what makes an educational Reel hold people’s attention.

6. Start your application with the word “EVOLVE” so I know you read the full description.



The shortlisted applicants will be offered a paid test edit using the same raw footage. I’m looking for someone I can build a long-term working relationship with.

title: Business Development Specialist – U.S. B2B Sales
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SPECIALIST – U.S. B2B SALES

Part-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Central Time



Applications close August 21, 2026



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 20 hours per week

Shift: U.S. Central Time business hours / Philippines night shift





ABOUT US



We are a growing U.S.-based copier and printer rental company serving businesses and apartment communities throughout the Houston, Texas area.



We provide businesses with flat-rate copier rental solutions that include equipment, toner, maintenance, and service. Our goal is to make office printing simple, reliable, and hassle-free while delivering excellent customer service.



We are building a modern sales operation that combines strong human communication with CRM, prospecting tools, automation, and AI.



We are looking for an energetic, self-motivated, dependable, and results-driven Business Development Specialist to help grow our business through outbound prospecting, relationship building, and closing new customer accounts.



This is intended to become a long-term role for the right person.





IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is a remote position, but it is a scheduled-hours position, not a freelance role where work can be completed whenever convenient.



During your agreed working hours, you are expected to be available, responsive, and focused on this role.





WORK MONITORING IS REQUIRED



We use company-approved time and activity monitoring during scheduled paid working hours.



Acceptance of work monitoring is a condition of employment. If you are not comfortable using monitoring software, please do not apply.



Monitoring may include:



* Time tracking

* Work activity monitoring

* Periodic screenshots during scheduled work hours



The purpose is accountability and visibility in a remote work environment.





OTHER JOBS OR CLIENTS



You may have other employment or freelance clients outside your scheduled hours.



However, you must disclose any ongoing employment or client commitments that could overlap with this position.



You may not perform work for another employer or client during the hours you are being paid to work with us.





30-DAY PAID PROBATIONARY PERIOD



All new hires begin with a 30-day paid probationary period.



The probationary period allows both sides to determine whether the position is a strong long-term fit.



During probation, we will evaluate:



* Attendance and punctuality

* Reliability and communication

* Ability to follow instructions

* CRM discipline

* Prospect research quality

* Comfort making outbound calls

* Written communication

* Ability to learn our products and market

* Consistency during scheduled working hours

* Progress toward agreed milestones



Successful completion of probation may lead to increased responsibility, compensation progression, performance incentives, and eventually a full-time opportunity.





FIRST 30-DAY MILESTONES



You will not simply be placed on the phone on Day 1.



We believe in building the right foundation first.





PHASE 1 – TRAINING AND SETUP



You will learn:



* Our copier rental business

* Our target customers

* Our pricing and offerings

* Our CRM

* Prospecting tools

* Calling systems

*
 outreach

* AI-assisted research and prospecting

* Our sales process





PHASE 2 – PROSPECTING



You will begin:



* Researching target accounts

* Identifying decision-makers

* Building qualified prospect lists

* Updating CRM records

* Preparing outreach campaigns





ATTENTION TO DETAIL CHECK



If you are still reading this posting carefully, include the words "Foundation First" somewhere in your application.



Do not place these words in the first line of your application.



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.





PHASE 3 – LIVE OUTREACH



Once the foundation is ready, you will begin:



* Cold calling

*
 outreach

* Follow-ups

* Lead qualification

* Quote preparation

* Pipeline management



Compensation progression and incentives will be based on successfully reaching agreed milestones and demonstrating consistent performance.





RESPONSIBILITIES



* Research and identify prospective customers

* Build and maintain high-quality prospect lists

* Identify business owners, office managers, property managers, and other decision-makers

* Conduct outbound cold calls to businesses and apartment communities

* Send personalized
 outreach and follow-up communications

* Qualify leads and identify customer needs

* Schedule sales conversations when appropriate

* Prepare quotations and rental agreements

* Help close new customer accounts

* Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activities

* Document calls,
s, follow-ups, and next steps

* Work closely with our operations team to ensure smooth customer handoff

* Reactivate previously inactive customers

* Meet weekly activity, pipeline, and sales goals





QUALIFICATIONS



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Previous B2B sales or business development experience

* Strong communication and relationship-building skills

* Comfortable making outbound sales calls

* Confident speaking with U.S. business customers

* Organized, self-motivated, and dependable

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow processes and maintain accurate CRM records

* Willingness to be accountable for activity and results





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* HubSpot

* Apollo

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* Salesforce

* Zoho

* Dialers or VoIP systems

* Google Workspace

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* AI prospecting or sales automation tools



Experience in the copier industry is not required. We will train you.





TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS



Because this is a remote position during U.S. business hours, reliable technology is essential.



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed primary internet

* A backup internet connection, such as a mobile hotspot or secondary provider

* Modern computer capable of running browser-based sales tools

* Quality headset

* Quiet and professional workspace

* Webcam

* Ability to participate reliably in Zoom or Google Meet meetings

* Ability to share your screen when training or reviewing work



Repeated connectivity problems or inability to reliably work the agreed schedule may result in termination during probation.





ATTENDANCE AND COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Remote work requires excellent communication.



During scheduled working hours, you are expected to:



* Be online and ready at the agreed start time

* Be reachable through our primary communication system

* Attend scheduled meetings on time

* Notify us promptly if an emergency prevents you from working

* Provide reasonable notice when requesting schedule changes

* Maintain accurate time records

* Provide brief progress updates when requested



Repeated no-shows, unexplained absences, or disappearing during scheduled working hours will not be acceptable.





COMPENSATION



USD $500–$625 per month for 20 hours per week, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.



Compensation includes:



* Paid 30-day probationary period

* Milestone-based compensation progression

* Performance incentives

* Bonuses for qualified opportunities and/or closed accounts

* Compensation reviews based on demonstrated performance

* Opportunity to transition to full-time employment

* Increased responsibility and compensation as the business grows



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship, not simply another temporary assignment.





BEFORE YOU APPLY



Please answer all of the following questions.



Incomplete applications may not be considered.



* Tell us about your B2B sales experience. What products or services have you sold?



* Describe your biggest sales achievement.



* Tell us about your cold-calling experience. Approximately how many outbound calls were you making per day or week?



* What sales and CRM tools have you used? Examples: HubSpot, Apollo, Salesforce, Zoho, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.



* Are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. Central Time business hours?



* Do you currently work for another employer or have ongoing freelance clients? If yes, please explain your working hours.



* Are you comfortable using company-approved time and activity monitoring software during your scheduled paid working hours?



* What is your primary internet connection and approximate speed?



* What backup internet connection do you have if your primary connection fails?



* Write a short
 of 150 words or less introducing our copier rental service to a Houston-area business customer.



* Please provide a 1–2 minute video introduction explaining why you believe you are the right fit for this role.



* Please provide details for one previous employer or supervisor who may be contacted as a reference.





To confirm that you have read the posting, begin your cover letter with the words:



"Houston Growth."



Remember: there is also a second attention-to-detail instruction elsewhere in this posting.





WHY JOIN US?



* Work directly with the founder of a growing U.S. company

* Make a measurable impact on business growth

* Learn modern B2B sales and prospecting systems

* Gain experience with CRM, automation, AI, and outbound sales tools

* Help build a sales engine rather than simply follow scripts

* Long-term opportunity with room to grow

* Opportunity to transition from part-time to full-time

* Performance is recognized and rewarded



We value people who are dependable, curious, accountable, professional, and motivated to grow.



If you enjoy speaking with customers, are comfortable being measured on results, and want to help build something meaningful, we would like to hear from you.



Applications close August 21, 2026.

title: Technical SEO Specialist
description:
What is LegalBuzz



LegalBuzz is a platform that's changing how law firms get found, trusted, and chosen in the age of AI.



When people need a lawyer today, they're not just searching Google; they're asking ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI-powered search engines to recommend one. Most law firms have no idea this is happening, let alone how to show up in those results. That's the problem LegalBuzz solves.



We combine proven SEO with AI search optimisation to make sure our clients (law firms across the UK, Australia, the USA, and Canada, including Legal 500 firms) get found wherever their clients are looking, and turn that visibility into real enquiries.



The Role



We're looking for a Technical SEO Specialist who keeps our clients' sites fast, crawlable, indexable, and structured to win, in both traditional search and AI search.



You'll own the technical side of every client account: audits, fixes, site architecture, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and making sure both Googlebot and AI crawlers can read and trust every page. Content and links only work when the technical foundation is right; that foundation is your job.



Law firm sites bring their own technical mess: legacy CMS builds, bloated themes, duplicate practice-area pages, broken redirects from old rebrands, and location pages that cannibalise each other. You'll see all of it, and you'll fix it.



The measure of your work is simple: enquiries for our clients. Crawl stats and site health scores matter, but leads are the result we're paid for.



What You'll Do

> Run full technical audits on client sites: crawlability, indexation, site speed, mobile usability, redirects, duplicate content, and internal linking

> Prioritise and ship fixes, working with our dev team or directly in the CMS where possible

> Own site architecture: URL structure, silo/internal linking logic, and pagination for practice areas and location pages

> Implement and maintain structured data (LocalBusiness, LegalService, FAQ, Attorney/Person schema) and keep it valid

> Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and page experience across the portfolio

> Ensure sites are fully readable and citable by AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) as well as Googlebot: rendering, robots directives, llms.txt where relevant

> Manage site migrations and redesigns: redirect mapping, pre/post-launch checks, and ranking protection

> Set up and maintain Search Console, rank tracking, and technical monitoring so problems are caught before clients notice

> Report clearly on technical health and the impact of fixes, in language a solicitor understands

> Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable, Read Before Applying)



We get a lot of applications from people with SEO certificates and no real experience. We will not shortlist them. If you cannot prove all five of the below, do not apply.



Proven, hands-on experience fixing real websites. Not audits that sat in a slide deck. You have personally diagnosed and fixed technical issues on live sites (crawl problems, indexation failures, broken redirects, speed issues, rendering problems) and you can show the before and after. Rankings recovered, pages indexed, traffic back. Real sites, real fixes, real results.



Proven experience with the right tools, including Screaming Frog. Screaming Frog is non-negotiable; you use it fluently (crawl configuration, custom extraction, comparing crawls, finding issues at scale). Alongside it: Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse, and a rank tracking platform (we use SE Ranking). Log file analysis experience is a strong plus. If you've never run a Screaming Frog crawl yourself, do not apply.



A proven track record you will be asked to show. Bring real examples to the call: an audit you ran, the issues you found, the fixes you shipped, and what happened afterwards, with numbers. No examples, no interview. "I followed a checklist" is not a track record.



Deep understanding of how technical SEO drives results, not just clean reports. You know which issues actually move rankings and enquiries and which are tool noise. You prioritise by impact. If your instinct is to fix every orange flag in an audit tool before the issues that are blocking indexation, this is not your role.



Deep, end-to-end technical knowledge. Crawling and indexation, rendering (including JavaScript), site speed and Core Web 



Vitals, structured data, redirects and status codes, and site architecture. You can explain why behind every fix, not just what.



Also required:



> Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and enough JavaScript to diagnose rendering issues

> Experience briefing developers clearly and checking their work

> Understanding of how AI search and LLM crawlers change technical requirements

> Self-directed: you can own an audit-to-fix pipeline without hand-holding

> Strong written English; your reports go to clients



Nice to have: experience with law firm or professional services sites, WordPress at scale, and site migration projects.



Why LegalBuzz

We're ahead of the curve. AI search is reshaping how clients find law firms, and we're at the front of it. You'll be solving technical problems most SEOs haven't even thought about yet.

Real traction. We work with a growing portfolio of clients, including Legal 500 firms. Your work is visible and tied directly to results.

Genuine ownership. You own the technical roadmap for your accounts; your fixes ship and your results show.

Direct line to the founder. No layers between you and the person making decisions.

Remote and flexible. Work where you're most productive.

Success in 90 Days





Full technical audits completed across your assigned accounts, with prioritised fix roadmaps

Quick wins shipped: critical crawl/indexation issues, broken redirects, and schema errors resolved

Structured data live and valid on priority pages across the portfolio

Monitoring in place: Search Console, rank tracking, and alerts configured for every account

Measurable improvement in indexation, Core Web Vitals, or organic visibility on at least one priority account

Clients and the team trust your reports and your prioritisation calls

title: Customer Support Specialist – Shopify Dropshipping | Long-Term
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Support Specialist to join our growing e-commerce business long-term.



We operate multiple Shopify stores across international markets and are specifically looking for someone who already understands Shopify dropshipping customer support.



If you have worked with dropshipping stores before, you probably know the situations we deal with every day: shipping delays, tracking issues, supplier problems, wrong items, out-of-stock products, replacements, returns, refunds, and customers who sometimes require a little more patience and problem-solving.



You don't need to be a manager or know everything from day one. We have clear SOPs and will train you on our specific workflows.



What matters most is that you already understand e-commerce/dropshipping support, communicate well, learn quickly, and can think for yourself.



What you'll be doing



Your day-to-day work will include:



* Responding to customer
s

* Managing customer support through Gorgias

* Checking and managing orders in Shopify

* Handling shipping and tracking issues

* Communicating order issues with our fulfillment team

* Handling cancellations, replacements, returns, and refunds

* Finding reasonable solutions when something goes wrong

* Following up on unresolved customer cases

* Helping keep customers happy without unnecessarily refunding orders

* Flagging recurring problems when you notice them



We don't expect you to solve every situation independently from day one. You'll learn our policies, suppliers, workflows, and way of working during onboarding.



Who we're looking for



We're especially interested in someone who has:



* Previous customer support experience for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Experience using Shopify

* Experience with Gorgias, Re:amaze, Zendesk, or similar support platforms

* Good written English

* Experience handling shipping delays, tracking issues, refunds, replacements, and difficult customers

* Good judgment and common sense

* The ability to work independently once trained

* Reliable availability and communication



Experience with international dropshipping stores, suppliers, fulfillment agents, 17TRACK, ParcelPanel, PayPal disputes, or chargebacks is a strong plus.



We're looking for someone who wants to stay with us long-term and grow together with the business.



How to Apply



Start your application with the word DIAMOND so we know you read the full job post.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell me about your previous dropshipping experience.



What type of stores did you work with, what were your responsibilities, and how long did you work there?



2. Tell me about a difficult customer situation you personally handled.



What happened, and what did you do?



3. A customer wants a full refund because their order is delayed, but the package is still in transit. How would you handle it?



4. Which platforms and tools have you used?



5. What is your weekly availability?



Please also include:



* (optional) Your resume/CV

* A screenshot of your current internet speed



We're not looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone reliable who understands dropshipping, communicates well, learns quickly, and wants to become a long-term part of the team.

title: Jawology — AI Video Ad Editor (VA) — Job Brief
description:
About Jawology



Jawology is an Australian direct-to-consumer clear aligner brand. We're building out a library of AI-generated video ads for Meta and other paid social channels, and are looking for a skilled remote video editor to own the end-to-end production of these ads.



Role Overview



We're looking for an experienced Video Editor / VA who is comfortable working with AI generation tools (Higgsfield, ElevenLabs) alongside a standard video editing program (e.g. CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve) to turn a creative brief into a polished 40–60 second ad, ready for Meta.



You'll be given a brief for each video (script, style direction, asset ideas) and will be responsible for producing the finished clip — sourcing/generating visuals, creating the voiceover, editing it all together, and delivering a video that flows naturally and looks professional.



We already have a couple of videos made using this workflow, so there's a clear reference point for quality and pacing.



Workflow You'll Be Following



1. Brief received (from Harley)



Voice script (goes into ElevenLabs)

Video style (cartoon, Pixar-style, realistic/live-action, etc.)

Suggested assets, ideas, and reference angles



2. Visual creation (Higgsfield)



Generate the base image for each clip in Higgsfield (can pull prompt ideas from Claude/ChatGPT or check in with Harley)

Use that image to generate the video clip in Higgsfield (again, prompts can be AI-assisted)



3. Assembly



Pull all generated clips into your video editing program of choice



4. Voiceover (ElevenLabs)



Generate voiceover using a genuine-sounding Australian female or male voice — this needs to sound like a real person, not robotic or "AI-ish"

Flag any words/phrases that sound off before finalizing

Get Harley's approval on the voiceover before locking it in



5. Final edit



Sync voiceover with clips

Re-time, trim, and re-cut clips as needed so the full video flows naturally start to finish

Deliver final export

What You'll Be Producing

40–60 second ad videos

Multiple creative angles/briefs over time (each brief is a distinct concept/script)

Target turnaround: under 5 hours per video once you're up to speed with the workflow

What We're Looking For

Proven experience with AI video/image generation tools — Higgsfield experience is a big plus (or strong experience with similar tools like Runway, Kling, Luma, Sora, etc. and a fast learning curve)

Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools, including an ear for what sounds "real" vs. robotic

Solid video editing skills in at least one major NLE (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Final Cut, etc.)

An eye for pacing, timing, and making cuts feel seamless with voiceover

Comfortable working from a creative brief and using your own judgment/AI tools to fill in visual gaps

Good communication — able to flag issues, ask clarifying questions, and share progress

Reliable, fast turnaround without sacrificing quality

Nice to Have

Experience creating ads for DTC / ecommerce brands

Familiarity with Meta ad creative specs and formats

Prior experience with faceless/AI-generated ad content specifically (not just traditional editing)

How to Apply



Please share:



Examples of any AI-generated video content you've created (Higgsfield or similar), ideally ads

Your general video editing portfolio/reel

Your estimated turnaround time per 40–60 second video, based on this workflow

Your availability (hours/week) and rate (per video or hourly)

Working Style



This is an ongoing, brief-by-brief role — you'll receive a newscript/concept regularly and work through the process independently, checking in with Harley at the voiceover approval step and whenever creative judgment calls come up.

title: Sage Intacct Migration Consultant (Contract / Project-Based) CPA Required
description:
About Firm Five



Firm Five is a fast-growing, CPA-led accounting and controllership firm serving clients across Canada and the United States.



We are currently supporting several private equity-backed and multi-entity organizations that are migrating from QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online to Sage Intacct and are looking for an experienced consultant to support these projects.



Contract Type:

Part-time

Project-based

Remote

Flexible hours

Ongoing opportunities for the right person





The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Sage Intacct consultant who has successfully completed QuickBooks-to-Intacct migrations and implementations.

This role will support our accounting and controller teams on client migration projects, particularly for multi-entity organizations with complex reporting requirements.



Responsibilities:

Lead or support Sage Intacct implementations

Design multi-entity structures within Sage Intacct

Build charts of accounts and dimensional reporting frameworks

Migrate historical data from QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online

Validate imported transactions and opening balances

Reconcile migrated financial data

Assist with testing and go-live activities

Provide best-practice recommendations for Sage Intacct setup

Support Firm Five controllers during implementation projects





Required Experience:

• Demonstrated Sage Intacct implementation experience

• Multiple completed QuickBooks ? Sage Intacct migrations

• Strong understanding of:

Multi-entity accounting

Consolidations

Intercompany transactions

Dimensions and reporting structures

Financial statement design



• Advanced Excel skills

• Strong English communication



Highly Preferred:

Previous experience working for a Sage Intacct implementation partner

CPA, CMA, or equivalent accounting designation

Private equity or portfolio-company experience

multi-location business experience

Ideal Candidate

You have personally completed Sage Intacct migrations before and can confidently guide a client from QuickBooks to a fully functioning Sage Intacct environment.

We’re not looking for someone who has simply used Sage Intacct—we’re looking for someone who has implemented it.



To Apply Please send:

Resume

Hourly rate (USD)

Number of Sage Intacct implementations completed

Number of QuickBooks ? Sage Intacct migrations completed

Largest multi-entity organization you’ve migrated

Brief summary of your role on those projects

Applications without Sage Intacct implementation experience will not be considered.



Answer the following question:

Have you personally led or significantly participated in a QuickBooks-to-Sage Intacct migration? If yes, please describe the project in 3-5 sentences.

title: Senior eCommerce Accountant (PHP 110,000 - 140,000 | Work with US Clients | Long-Term Role)
description:
Work directly with North American eCommerce brands.

Own real client financials. No micromanagement.



FULL-TIME ROLE — WE WILL NOT ENTERTAIN CANDIDATES WITH MULTIPLE CLIENTS



We’re a fast-growing accounting firm looking for a high-performing Senior Accountant who wants long-term stability, growth, and meaningful work.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role.

You will own the monthly close and financials for real businesses.



About Firm Five



Firm Five is a modern accounting firm supporting eCommerce and service businesses ($2M–$50M revenue) across the U.S. and Canada.



We don’t do tax work.

We focus on clean financials, strong systems, and helping clients make better decisions.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will fully own the accounting for multiple eCommerce clients.



This includes:



Monthly close in QBO or Xero

Reconciling Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, Amazon, and other platforms

Investigating discrepancies in payouts, fees, returns

Recording accruals, COGS, and inventory adjustments

Preparing clean monthly financial statements

Supporting onboarding and clean-up of messy books

Communicating clearly with clients and internal team



This Role Is NOT For You If:

You need constant supervision

You only have basic bookkeeping experience

You struggle with English communication

You are not comfortable working with international clients



This Role IS For You If:

You can own a full month-end close independently

You have worked with US/Canadian clients

You understand eCommerce accounting (or can learn quickly)

You take pride in clean, accurate financials

You communicate clearly and professionally



Requirements

CPA (Philippines)

3–5+ years of accounting experience

Strong QBO or Xero experience

Experience with eCommerce or inventory accounting

Strong English communication (written + spoken)

Reliable internet, backup power, and dedicated workspace



Nice to Have

Shopify / Amazon / A2X / Webgility experience

Experience with multi-entity or multi-currency accounting



Compensation & Benefits

PHP 110,
,000

Paid bi-weekly via Wise

Paid holidays + vacation + sick days

Long-term, stable role

No time tracking or micromanagement

Clear expectations and growth path

Working Hours

Flexible schedule

Must overlap with EST (9 AM – 1 PM EST)

Remaining hours flexible

How to Apply



Send your resume via a Google Drive link.



We are building a high-performance team.



If you are looking for a long-term role where you can grow, take ownership, and work with serious clients — we’d love to meet you.

title: Scriptwriter for a YouTube Channel
description:
YouTube Scriptwriter (Remote)



Location: Remote

Hours: Part-Time

Company: JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers worldwide.



Our mission is to create highly engaging content that reaches millions of viewers across YouTube and other digital platforms. We're currently looking to hire 2 talented Scriptwriters to help produce compelling, high-retention videos for the BlooGaming YouTube channel.



The Role



As a YouTube Scriptwriter, you'll be responsible for creating engaging, high-retention scripts that keep viewers watching from beginning to end.



You'll work closely with our Quality Lead to refine and improve every script before it is finalized. This role requires someone who is comfortable receiving detailed feedback, making multiple rounds of revisions, and improving their scripts based on feedback and performance goals.



We are looking for a writer who doesn't just submit a first draft, but takes ownership of the entire writing process — from the initial concept and first draft through revisions and final approval.



This role is ideal for someone who understands what makes YouTube content successful and enjoys turning ideas into entertaining, fast-paced narratives.



Responsibilities

Write 1–2 high-quality YouTube scripts per day for the BlooGaming channel.

Create strong hooks, engaging openings, and compelling story structures designed to maximize viewer retention.

Collaborate closely with the Quality Lead to revise, rewrite, and improve scripts based on feedback.

Be comfortable completing multiple rounds of revisions when necessary until a script meets our quality and retention standards.

Take feedback constructively and apply it accurately rather than simply making surface-level changes.

Identify weaknesses in a script's pacing, structure, storytelling, jokes, hooks, or overall engagement and proactively improve them.

Use Google Docs to draft, edit, revise, and collaborate on scripts.

Analyze YouTube Studio data to understand viewer behavior and apply insights to improve future content.

Continuously improve script structure, pacing, hooks, and storytelling based on performance metrics.

Brainstorm fresh video ideas and creative story progressions that keep viewers engaged throughout each video.

Stay up to date with YouTube trends, storytelling techniques, and audience retention strategies.

Meet daily deadlines while maintaining a consistently high standard of writing.



Requirements

Excellent written and spoken English.

Proven experience writing YouTube scripts or similar long-form digital content.

Strong understanding of YouTube audience retention, viewer psychology, pacing, hooks, and storytelling.

Ability to analyze YouTube Studio analytics and translate insights into better-performing scripts.

Strong revision skills and the ability to significantly improve a script based on feedback.

Comfortable receiving direct and detailed creative feedback from a Quality Lead.

Ability to complete revisions quickly and accurately while maintaining the original intent and improving the overall quality of the script.

Creative thinker with the ability to develop engaging narratives and keep viewers invested throughout a video.

Highly organized with excellent time management skills.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while meeting daily deadlines.

Willingness to write, revise, and refine scripts until they meet the required quality standard.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience writing gaming-related content.

Experience working with YouTube creators or digital media companies.

Knowledge of Minecraft or gaming content is a plus.

Familiarity with YouTube trends, analytics, and content optimization.

Experience working in a fast-paced content production environment where scripts go through multiple rounds of feedback and revisions.



What We Offer

Work with one of the world's largest creator businesses.

Collaborate with an experienced creative team focused on producing high-performing YouTube content.

Fully remote work environment.

Opportunity to contribute to content viewed by millions of people worldwide.

Professional growth within a fast-paced and innovative media company.



How to Apply



We're looking to hire 2 Scriptwriters and would love to see your work.



Please submit your application to 
 with the subject line:



JVDB Scriptwriter



Please include:



Your updated resume.

Your portfolio or samples of YouTube scripts, creative writing, or similar work that best showcases your storytelling abilities.

Completion of the Scriptwriter Trial Task below.

Scriptwriter Trial Task



As part of our recruitment process, shortlisted applicants are required to complete a Scriptwriter Trial Task.



Trial Task:





The trial task is designed to evaluate your ability to create engaging YouTube scripts, structure a compelling story, maintain viewer retention, and respond to feedback and make effective revisions.



Please make sure you complete the trial task as part of your application.



Applications without a resume, portfolio/writing samples, or completed trial task may not be considered.



We are looking for writers who wants to go to the next level!

description:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Come join our dynamic, award-winning cloud technology consulting firm!



Are you passionate about empowering small businesses to achieve their greatest potential through technology? 



We’re looking for a Key Account Manager to be the trusted partner for our clients, driving retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth. If you’re passionate about technology, problem-solving, and making a real impact, this is your chance to shine.



We’re itGenius, a leading cloud technology consulting firm and Google’s top partner in Australia. For over a decade, we’ve helped small and mid-sized businesses across the globe transform how they work with Google Workspace, AI, and automation. Our business model combines consulting expertise with scalable managed services that empower modern teams to do their best work.



If you’re an A-player—apply now!





Why You’ll Love Working With Us

We don’t just offer a job—we offer a career with exceptional rewards, growth opportunities, and a people-first culture. Here’s what you’ll get:

Job Overview: 

As a Key Account Manager for IT Managed Services customers, you will be at the forefront of this mission, acting as a trusted partner and advisor to our valued clients.



You’ll manage a portfolio of around 30 SMB clients, each worth between $6K and $80K in annual gross profit. You will be instrumental in ensuring their continued success, identifying opportunities for them to leverage technology more effectively. This role is about building lasting relationships, driving mutual growth, and ensuring our clients experience the “Amazon Prime” of IT service — effortless, responsive, and world class.



You will be directly accountable for client retention, satisfaction, and the growth of your assigned accounts, contributing significantly to itGenius’s 10-year goal of becoming the global leader in remote-delivered IT services to the SMB market.



Accountabilities:

The Key Account Manager is specifically accountable for the following measurable objectives within their assigned client portfolio:



* Holding the Game Plan: Accountable for holding a client’s long-term objectives and ensuring the plan is constantly moved forward over time via quarterly reviews.



* Client Partnership: Holding relationships with key decision-makers within assigned client accounts, positioning itGenius as a trusted technology partner.



* Client Retention & Satisfaction: Accountable for maintaining high levels of client satisfaction and ensuring the retention of assigned client accounts.



* Revenue Growth: Accountable for identifying and securing opportunities for revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell within their assigned client portfolio.



Key Responsibilities: 

To achieve the above accountabilities, the Key Account Manager will perform the following day-to-day activities:



* Relationship Management: Proactively engage with assigned clients through regular meetings (virtual and in-person where appropriate), calls, and
 communications to understand their evolving business needs and technology landscape.



* Needs Assessment & Solution Proposal: Conduct thorough needs analyses to identify client challenges and opportunities, and present tailored IT solutions and services that align with their strategic objectives and our service offerings.



* Sales & Negotiation: Prepare and deliver proposals, negotiate contracts, and manage the sales cycle for upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts to achieve revenue targets.



* Client Advocacy & Issue Resolution: Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, advocating for their needs internally and collaborating with the technical, support, and project teams to ensure timely and effective resolution of any issues or escalations.



* Billing & Account Administration: Chase unpaid invoices, resolve billing queries, and manage account reconciliations for assigned clients.



* Cancellations & Offboarding: Manage the cancellation and offboarding process for departing clients, ensuring a professional handover and capturing lessons for retention.



* Account Planning & Review: Develop and maintain comprehensive account plans for each assigned client, including key contacts, service history, future opportunities, and conduct regular business reviews to demonstrate value and align on future strategies.



* CRM Management & Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date client information, communication logs, and sales pipeline data within the CRM system. Prepare and present regular reports on account health, sales performance, and client satisfaction to the Head of Sales & Accounts.



* Market Awareness: Stay informed about industry trends, technological advancements, and the competitive landscape to better advise clients and identify new opportunities.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or related field

5–8+ years in account management, sales, or client services, ideally in IT/technology/SaaS. 

Experience in an MSP environment or familiarity with managed IT services delivery is an advantage.

Proven track record in client retention, revenue growth, and account expansion.

Client Relationship & Strategy: Build trusted partnerships with senior decision-makers. Develop account plans, conduct business reviews, and identify growth opportunities.

Sales & Solution Selling: Skilled in proposal creation, contract negotiation, upsell/cross-sell, and delivering tailored IT solutions.

Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written skills; adept at presenting to executives and working seamlessly with internal teams.

CRM & Reporting: Proficient in CRM tools for tracking accounts, pipeline management, and reporting on KPIs.

Leadership & Mentoring: Mentor junior account managers and contribute to process improvements.

title: Amazon Troubleshooting Expert
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Amazon Troubleshooting Specialist to manage, diagnose, and resolve issues affecting Amazon seller accounts, product listings, orders, inventory, payments, and overall marketplace performance.



The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to investigate complex account and listing issues while working within Amazon’s policies and guidelines.



Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and troubleshoot issues within Amazon Seller Central, including account, listing, inventory, order, payment, and performance-related problems.

* Investigate and resolve listing suppressions, stranded inventory, inactive listings, ASIN issues, category restrictions, and product detail page errors.

* Diagnose account health issues, including policy warnings, performance notifications, intellectual property complaints, authenticity concerns, and other account-related restrictions.

* Prepare and submit appeals, Plans of Action (POAs), and case responses to Amazon Seller Support.

* Follow up on unresolved Amazon cases and escalate issues when necessary.

* Troubleshoot FBA-related issues, including receiving discrepancies, inventory adjustments, stranded inventory, removals, reimbursements, and fulfillment problems.

* Investigate order and customer-related issues, including cancellations, refunds, returns, delivery problems, and order defects.

* Identify and resolve product listing and catalog issues, including incorrect attributes, variations, images, titles, descriptions, and product information.

* Review Amazon account metrics and identify potential issues that may negatively affect seller performance.

* Maintain accurate records of troubleshooting activities, Amazon cases, resolutions, and follow-up actions.

* Coordinate with internal teams such as operations, catalog, customer service, inventory, and management to resolve marketplace issues.

* Stay updated on Amazon policies, Seller Central changes, marketplace requirements, and best practices.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to prevent future problems.

* Provide clear status updates and communicate complex Amazon issues in an easy-to-understand manner.

title: Social Media Sales Appointment Setter (Full-Time) | Base + Commission | US Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time (40 hrs/week)



**Salary:** Monthly base retainer + performance commission on closed sales (details discussed at interview)



**ABOUT US**



We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 95,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 200 to 300 outbound DMs per day across our platforms (TikTok is the top priority, then Instagram, then
, then YouTube)

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- A guaranteed monthly base retainer, paid regardless of performance, so you always have a stable floor

- Plus performance commission on every booked call that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report every week, so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side

- Exact figures are shared at the interview stage



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word and the subject of the message. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: approximately 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday to Friday. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role.

- Experience as an appointment setter, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche is a big plus)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and
 
 interfaces

- Calendly experience is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches you have worked in

3. Your response to this scenario, written exactly as you would send it: A woman comments "I needed to hear this" on one of our videos about why undereating stalls fat loss. Write your opening DM to her.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.



---



One honest heads-up: on OnlineJobs.ph, listings without any salary figure get noticeably fewer applicants, since experienced setters filter by pay. The "well above typical setter rates" and "premium pays triple entry" lines are there to compensate for that, but if application volume comes in thin after a week, adding just a total earnings range (without revealing the base/commission split) is the usual fix.

title: Operations Manager — Coaching Program (AI & Automation) | Long-Term, Full-Time
description:
Read this part first

If you're looking for a job where someone tells you what to do each morning, this isn't it. We already have people who can hand out tasks. What we don't have is someone who looks at how we run, sees what's broken, and fixes it before anyone asks.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — save yourself the application.



Who we are

We're Digital Kairos. We run Brick by Brick, a cohort-based coaching program that helps consultants, coaches, and business owners build their brand and get clients on LinkedIn. Members join in classes of about 30, do daily homework, hit milestones, get on teaching calls, and lay bricks — literally, we mail them one.



We're a small remote team, mostly US-based, and we move fast. Our members pay real money and they get real results, and the reason that works is that the operations behind them are tight. Right now those operations run on people remembering things. We want them to run on systems.



That's your job.

-------------------



What you'll actually do:

Run the machine. Every cohort has a rhythm: applications come in, people get approved, they pay, they get onboarded, they get channels and access, they do homework, they hit milestones, they unlock calls, they graduate, some move up to our next-level program. You own all of it, start to finish, for every member. Nothing slips through.



Build the machine. This is the part that matters most. Right now too much of the above happens by hand — 30 individual messages sent one at a time, progress counted manually across 30 channels, recordings uploaded one by one. You'll use Claude, Zapier, and whatever else works to automate it, so the next class costs us less time than the last one. We already have a list of things waiting to be built. You'll add to it.



Organize us. Our team lives in Slack and we're mid-migration into Notion. Things live in three places and belong in one. You'll bring structure — clean systems, written processes, one source of truth — and hold us to it.



Take care of our members. You'll message our members more than anyone else on our team does. When someone falls behind, you notice. When someone's confused, you fix it before it becomes a complaint. When someone wins, you catch it and make sure it gets celebrated. This part isn't admin work — it's the experience people paid for.



Tell us what's happening. Over-communicate. Every week we want to know what shipped, what's at risk, what you noticed, and what you're changing. If you go quiet, we assume something's wrong.



-------------------



Your first 90 days

So you know this is a real job with real work waiting, here's some of what's actually sitting on the list:



- Write the cohort rulebook — every deadline, threshold, and unlock in one document, so nobody has to ask again

- Automate our application and onboarding flow (it's been on our list since June)

- Fix a broken Zapier automation between our contract and invoicing tools

- Automate our milestone messages, which are currently sent by hand, one member at a time

- Build a dashboard that shows who's behind, replacing manual counting

- Write our offboarding process, which currently exists only in people's heads



-------------------



What you need to have

- 2+ years running operations for a cohort program, membership, mastermind, online course, or coaching business. You've done this specific kind of work, not adjacent work.

- Slack at an admin level — channels, user groups, workflows, permissions

- Notion as a builder — you make databases and views, you don't just fill them in

- Zapier or Make — you've built multi-step automations with conditional logic, and you've debugged one that broke at a bad time

- AI as a daily tool. We run on Claude. You should already be using AI to do your actual work, not experimenting with it on the side. If you've set up projects, custom instructions, or recurring automated tasks, say so.

- Skool, Zoom, Calendly, Google Workspace — or the confidence to be fluent in a week

- Excellent written English. You'll write messages that go directly to our paying members. We need to trust you to hit send.

- Availability that overlaps US business hours — roughly 9AM–5PM US Central, which is about 10PM–6AM Philippine time. Being straight with you: this is a night shift. Please only apply if that genuinely works for your life.





-------------------



Nice to have

- Dashboard building, other no-code tools, experience writing SOPs for a team that had none, experience running two cohorts at once.



Pay and growth

- $1,200 USD/month, full-time

- 90-day review with a clear path to $1,500/month — tied to documenting the cohort playbook and shipping two working automations, not to a calendar date

- Quarterly performance bonus tied to member completion rates and automations shipped

- 13th month pay

- Paid time off and Philippine holidays

- This is a long-term role with room above it. As we grow, this seat grows — more programs, more systems, and eventually people to lead. We're hiring someone to build a career here, not to fill a gap.



-------------------



What working with us is like

We're direct and we move fast. We'd rather you try something and get it wrong than wait for permission. If you're stuck for more than an hour, ask — but come with what you already tried.



We don't micromanage, and we don't want to. The tradeoff is that we need you to be the kind of person who doesn't need it. For the first 30 days a teammate will review your member-facing messages while you learn our voice. After that, you send them yourself.



----------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

Read this carefully. We're using it to filter, and most applications will not make it past this section.



1. Subject line. Use exactly this, filling in the blank with your favorite automation tool:

Brick by Brick Ops — [your favorite automation tool]



2. In your message, answer these two questions. Keep it short — a few sentences each. We care about specifics, not polish.



Q1. Tell us about one workflow you automated. What tool did you use, what broke, and what did you do about it?

Q2. Here's a real situation. You have 30 members. Nine of them are behind on homework. There's a teaching call in four hours, and the rule for this week's homework requirement isn't written down anywhere. What do you do in your first hour — and what would you build so this never happens again?



3. Record a 2-minute Loom and paste the link. We watch all of them, and we can tell when it's the same video sent to fifty companies. Answer these three, in order:



(0:00–0:30) Who are you and what do you do now?

(0:30–1:15) Show us how you actually use AI in your work. Don't describe it — share your screen and walk us through something real you built or use.

(1:15–2:00) What made you apply to this job specifically? And tell us one thing you'd change about how we've described the role, or something you noticed we might be getting wrong.



Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed. Applications with a generic Loom won't either.



-------------------



What happens next: if your Loom lands, we'll send you a short practical exercise — about an hour, using a real (anonymized) week from our program. Then one conversation with our founder and our Head of Community, then an offer. We move quickly.



We're excited to meet you. Please only apply if you read all of this — we'll know.

title: Senior iOS Fintech QA Tester — Payments, UX & TestFlight
description:
We are looking for an experienced mobile QA tester to perform a complete, hands-on audit of Kronos, an iOS fintech app distributed through TestFlight.

This is not a basic “click around and report bugs” role. We need someone who understands structured QA, payment workflows, asynchronous transaction states, edge cases, mobile UX, and regression testing. You should be able to identify problems, reproduce them reliably, explain their likely impact, and recommend specific improvements.

You will test the entire app, including:

Signup, onboarding, login and account recovery

Identity verification and profile management

Home screen, balances and account information



Sending, receiving and adding funds

Domestic and international transfers

Quotes, exchange rates, fees and transfer statuses

Processing, completed, failed, refunded and duplicate transaction states

Membership plans, purchases, restoration and entitlement updates

Cards, savings, crypto and gig-income features

Referral rewards and birthday benefits

Airport lounge search, suggestions, images and booking links

Notifications, requests, transaction history and support flows

Keyboard behavior, forms, validation and long-text handling

Loading states, offline behavior, slow networks and interrupted sessions

App relaunching, backgrounding, crashes and performance



Do not apply if your reports only say things like “button not working.” We need detailed evidence, reliable reproduction steps, severity assessment and thoughtful recommendations.



When applying, include

Examples of previous QA reports with sensitive information removed

iPhone models and iOS versions available to you

Your experience testing payments or fintech products

Tools you use for network, performance and crash investigation

How you would investigate a transfer that appears twice or changes from processing to refunded

title: Image Data Annotation
description:
We're building an image editing product and need detail-oriented reviewers to check the quality of image cutouts and edits. What you'll do

title: ADVERTISING VIDEO CREATIVE SPECIALIST / AI AD CREATOR
description:
ADVERTISING VIDEO CREATIVE SPECIALIST / AI AD CREATOR



Remote | Freelance | As-Needed



$5–$25 Per Finished Video, Depending on Quality, Complexity & Expectations



I am looking for a highly creative Advertising Video Specialist who can create STUNNING short-form advertisements that capture attention, tell a compelling story, and make people remember the product or service.



THIS IS NOT A NORMAL VIDEO EDITING JOB.



I am NOT simply looking for someone to cut clips together, add subtitles, and put music underneath.



I am looking for someone who understands how to CREATE AN ADVERTISEMENT.



The goal is to make someone stop scrolling, become curious, stay until the end, remember the advertisement, and ultimately become interested in the product or service.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



Videos will generally be LESS THAN 90 SECONDS.



You may be given a basic concept, product, service, or idea and expected to turn it into a creative advertisement.



You should be able to take a simple concept and turn it into something much more powerful through:



* Creative storytelling

* Strong hooks

* Interesting visual concepts

* AI-generated content

* Stock footage and images

* Original visuals

* Background music

* Sound effects

* Motion graphics

* Text and captions

* Creative transitions

* Emotional storytelling

* Strong calls to action



The advertisement should feel like something people WANT to watch, rather than something that simply tells them to buy something.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who can think:



"How can I make this person stop scrolling?"



"How can I keep them watching until the end?"



"How can I make them remember this advertisement?"



"How can I present this product or service in a way they have never seen before?"



You should be creative, imaginative, and able to think OUTSIDE THE BOX.



AI tools are absolutely welcome.



If you know how to use AI video generators, AI images, voice generation, animation tools, or other creative AI tools to produce advertisements that look professional and unique, that is a major advantage.



However, AI experience alone is NOT enough.



We care about the FINAL RESULT.



ORTHODOX JEWISH COMMUNITY CONTENT



A significant portion of our advertising projects may involve products, services, businesses, or themes connected to the ORTHODOX JEWISH COMMUNITY.



Previous experience with the Orthodox Jewish community is a PLUS, but it is NOT required.



If you are hired, however, you must be willing to LEARN and conduct appropriate research whenever a project involves this community.



You may need to understand things such as the audience, terminology, culture, values, appropriate imagery, modesty considerations, and the type of messaging that would be appropriate for the specific audience.



You do not need to already be an expert.



What matters is that you are willing to research, learn, ask questions when necessary, and create content that is accurate, respectful, and appropriate for the intended audience.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



* Experienced advertising video creator

* Strong understanding of marketing and audience psychology

* Excellent storytelling ability

* Creative and highly imaginative

* Understands how to create strong hooks

* Understands viewer retention

* Can create memorable advertisements

* Excellent sense of music and sound

* Can use visuals creatively

* Comfortable using AI creative tools

* Can turn a basic idea into a compelling advertisement

* Extremely detail-oriented

* Able to work quickly and meet deadlines

* Willing to research unfamiliar audiences and subjects



You do NOT need to use any particular software or AI platform.



Use whatever professional tools you believe will create the BEST result.



THE AUDIENCE



Our advertisements may promote many different products, services, businesses, websites, jobs, and opportunities.



Some advertisements may target the general U.S. market, while others may target specific communities, including the Orthodox Jewish community.



You should be able to adapt your creative style to different audiences and products.



HOW TO APPLY



STEP 1 – CONTACT US



Send a WhatsApp message to:




Begin your message with:



"Advertising Video Specialist"



In your message, briefly explain how you understand this project and what you believe makes a GREAT advertising video different from ordinary video editing.



STEP 2 – SEND YOUR TOP 3 SAMPLES



Send your TOP 3 examples of advertisements or promotional videos you have personally created.



Please choose examples that demonstrate:



* Creativity

* Storytelling

* Audience engagement

* Strong hooks

* Marketing

* Product or service promotion



Do NOT simply send random video-editing samples.



We specifically want to see your ability to create ADVERTISEMENTS.



STEP 3 – JOIN THE WHATSAPP GROUP



After your initial WhatsApp message and samples, you will be given instructions to join our WhatsApp group:



After your initial WhatsApp message and samples, you will be given instructions to join our WhatsApp group:



WhatsApp Group:







you will be waiting to join till i approve you. I will only approve those whom videos samples I appreciate



CREATIVE SAMPLE COMPETITION



Inside the group, I will explain a specific advertising concept that I want created.



Interested candidates will have the opportunity to create a SHORT SAMPLE VIDEO based on that concept.



This allows me to see who can actually take an idea and turn it into a compelling advertisement.



The completed sample will be reviewed based on:



* Creativity

* Storytelling

* Attention-grabbing ability

* Viewer retention

* Visual quality

* Music and sound

* Marketing effectiveness

* Overall impact



SAMPLE PAYMENT



This is a PAID SAMPLE.



Each person who actually completes and submits the requested sample video will receive approximately $2 for the completed sample.



The sample payment is intentionally small because this is a short creative test and is NOT the regular compensation for the position.



Everyone who properly completes the requested sample will be paid for their work.



After reviewing the submissions, I expect to select approximately ONE OR TWO people to become our ongoing Advertising Video Specialists.



ONGOING COMPENSATION



The selected video specialists will generally be paid approximately:



$5–$25 PER VIDEO



The exact amount will depend on:



* Quality of the work

* Complexity of the concept

* Length of the video

* Amount of original content required

* AI or other production requirements

* Turnaround time

* Overall expectations for the project



Outstanding creators who consistently produce exceptional advertisements may receive higher compensation and more frequent projects.



IMPORTANT



This is NOT a guaranteed full-time position.



It is an ongoing FREELANCE opportunity.



Projects will be provided as needed.



If you are someone who loves creating advertisements, understands marketing, enjoys experimenting with new AI tools, and gets excited about turning a simple idea into something people remember, I would love to see your work.



We are looking for CREATIVITY, not just technical editing ability.



Want early access to new job opportunities before they are posted here? We sometimes fill roles directly from our WhatsApp group first. Join here to stay updated
