title: Service Coordinator
description:
Location: Tabuk City or surrounding Kalinga area, Philippines

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from home initially, transitioning to our future Tabuk City office



Reports to: Philippines Office Manager



About Elite Trades Australia

Elite Trades Australia is a Melbourne-based electrical and plumbing services company delivering residential, commercial, government, maintenance and energy-efficiency projects across Victoria. Our work includes electrical and plumbing services, hot-water and heat-pump installations, property upgrades, maintenance and project delivery.

We coordinate internal field teams and subcontractors through disciplined job-management, scheduling, compliance and documentation systems. Accuracy, ownership and timely escalation are essential to keeping our field operations running effectively.



About the Role

Coordinate daily and forward schedules for electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians and subcontractors.

Allocate jobs based on location, trade qualifications, availability, urgency, job scope and customer requirements.

Review incoming work orders, purchase orders and confirmed bookings, ensuring all required information is complete before scheduling.

Contact customers to book, confirm, reschedule and follow up on appointments.

Respond professionally and promptly to customer enquiries by phone,
 and SMS.

Provide customers with accurate appointment information, access requirements and service updates.

Monitor field progress throughout the day and respond quickly to delays, cancellations, access issues and urgent jobs.

Reallocate technicians and adjust schedules when operational changes occur.

Prepare and dispatch clear job instructions, documentation and special site requirements to field teams.

Maintain accurate job cards, customer details, notes, statuses and appointment records in ServiceM8.

Ensure scheduling and operational trackers remain accurate and up to date, with no unaddressed jobs or follow-ups.

Coordinate with warehouse and procurement teams to confirm that required equipment, stock and materials are available before appointments.

Liaise with field staff, subcontractors, project managers, retailers and other stakeholders to support smooth job delivery.

Follow up on incomplete jobs, return visits, outstanding information and customer actions until resolution.

Manage customer concerns and complaints professionally, escalating complex or sensitive matters when required.

Collect and follow up on completion documents, photographs, certificates and technician notes.

Ensure completed jobs are promptly handed over for compliance review and invoicing.

Track scheduling performance, cancellations, outstanding jobs, customer response times and completion rates.

Identify scheduling conflicts, operational risks and recurring service issues, and recommend practical improvements.

Maintain customer confidentiality and represent the company professionally in all communications.



Skills and Experience Required

Minimum two years’ experience in scheduling, service coordination, dispatch, customer service or a similar operational role.

Previous experience within electrical, plumbing, HVAC, construction, maintenance or another field-service business is highly regarded.

Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple technicians, subcontractors and customer appointments in a high-volume environment.

Strong spoken and written English, with professional telephone,
 and SMS communication skills.

Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities, urgent changes and tight deadlines without losing accuracy.

Strong customer-service skills, including the ability to manage complaints and difficult conversations professionally.

High attention to detail when entering customer, property, scheduling and job information.

Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound scheduling decisions under pressure.

Confidence using job-management systems, CRM platforms, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

Reliable, accountable and proactive, with a strong commitment to following tasks through to completion.

Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with field staff, customers and internal teams.

Strong teamwork skills and a willingness to support wider operational requirements when needed.



Highly Regarded

Previous experience using ServiceM8 or a similar field-service management system.

Knowledge of electrical, plumbing, air-conditioning, heat-pump or property-maintenance services.

Experience managing work orders, purchase orders, job documentation and completion records.

Familiarity with route planning and Melbourne metropolitan and regional locations.

Experience coordinating employed field teams and subcontractors.

A qualification in business administration, customer service or operations is advantageous but not essential.



How to Apply and Location Details

Applicants should live in Tabuk City or within a practical commuting distance of Tabuk City.

This position will begin as a work-from-home role. The successful applicant must be willing and able to transition to working from our future Tabuk City office when it opens.

Please provide:

1. Your updated résumé.

2. A link to a 2–3-minute recorded video introduction using Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform. In your video, please explain:

o Your previous administration or operations experience.

o Your experience with job scheduling, data entry, Excel, bookkeeping, or contractor coordination.

o Any experience using ServiceM8 or similar job-management software.

o How you maintain accuracy when managing multiple jobs and deadlines.

o Why you believe you are suitable for this position.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed.

4. Details of your computer and backup internet or power arrangements.

5. A Photo of your workstation. At least 2 screens required.

6. Your availability to work Australian business hours.

title: Office and Communications Manager
description:
Principle is a multidisciplinary commercial real estate firm working across appraisal and valuation, property tax consulting, brokerage, and capital advisory. We're a three-generation practice, and we're growing.



This is a genuinely broad role for someone who wants both halves of it.



The role



Two things, roughly half and half.



You'll own how we present ourselves. Our marketing and our brand — the collateral, the campaigns, the website content, the social presence, and the firm's voice in the market. We've built a strong brand system; you'll steward it and produce within it.



And you'll keep the firm running. Direct support to the Managing Partner, support across our accounting, production, research, and business development functions, and the administration of the office itself.



You'll work alongside our Operations Coordinator as a peer. She owns client engagements — intake, deadlines, delivery, invoicing. You own the firm itself: its presence, its office, and its people.



How the time splits

 

25% Marketing — collateral, website content,
 campaigns, event materials, and campaign support for business development

25% Communications and brand — social media, brand stewardship, thought leadership, and divisional positioning

50% Executive, firm, and office support — the Managing Partner, support to every other role, and office administration



We take these proportions seriously and review them quarterly. A role this broad drifts unless someone is watching, and we'd rather protect the creative work than watch it disappear into whatever's left on a Friday.



What you'll do



Marketing and communications



Produce collateral — brochures, one-pagers, capability statements, proposal and presentation templates

Keep website content current across the firm and divisional sites

Build and execute
 campaigns, including seasonal property tax outreach tied to county assessment calendars

Own the content calendar and produce the content: posts, graphics, short-form video

Draft thought leadership in the Managing Partner's voice

Steward the brand system and enforce it across everything we issue



Executive, firm, and office support



Calendar, travel, meeting coordination, and correspondence for the Managing Partner

Support across accounting, production, research, and business development — document preparation, formatting, data entry, scheduling, and file work

Office facilities, vendors, equipment, and systems administration

Track licences, insurance, registrations, and renewals as hard dates

Serve as coverage for the Operations Coordinator during absence

What we're looking for



Required



Marketing experience across digital and print, with real production capability — you'll make things, not only brief them

Social media management for a business, including producing content rather than only scheduling it

Strong writing, including the ability to write convincingly in someone else's voice

Administrative or office management experience in a professional services environment

Executive support experience, with the organization and discretion it requires

Comfort being interrupted, and the discipline to protect scheduled creative work anyway



Preferred



Professional services or commercial real estate background

Design tool proficiency

 marketing platform experience

title: Executive Business Partner & Project Manager
description:
The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading. 



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice’s behalf. 



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next. 



Our technology: We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. 



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. 



Position Overview: 

This role exists to keep the execution engine of the organization running. The Executive Business Partner & Project Manager sits inside the President and CEO's meeting cadence, owns follow-through on every action item across the business, and provides the calendar and scheduling backbone that keeps both executives' time in sync. Success looks like nothing falling through the cracks: every decision reaches a documented conclusion, every open loop is tracked to closure, and every meeting opens with a clear readout of what's done, what's pending, and what's overdue. 



Key Responsibilities:



• Schedule and host the recurring business and functional leadership meeting cadence for the President and CEO, serving as an embedded partner in day-to-day operations 



•Review meeting transcripts and recordings for accuracy and clarity on follow-up items and open action items 



•Assign every action item to a named, accountable owner immediately following each meeting, and proactively follow up with owners between meetings to confirm status before it's due 



•Drive follow-up and decisions to specific, documented conclusions rather than leaving items open-ended 



•Codify outcomes into a clear record of what was d
 versus what was noted, and carry that record forward into the next recurring meeting for continuity 



•Open each meeting with a status readout covering closed items, open loops, and anything past due 



•Provide calendar and scheduling support for the President and CEO to prevent conflicts and eliminate overlap 



•Coordinate cross-functionally between executive leadership and the development/operations teams, and support the transition of legacy operating practices into AI-supported workflows 



•Partner with product managers and cross-functional leaders across the business to align priorities and drive follow-through, extending beyond the immediate development team. 



•Balance strategic and tactical execution — operate at the level of executive intent while also driving the granular, day-to-day follow-through needed to close items out. 



•Exercise discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive business information encountered through leadership meetings and communications. 



•Represent executive leadership's priorities and intent when following up with stakeholders, ensuring alignment without requiring constant direct input. 



•Additional tasks assigned 



Required Qualifications:

• Years of experience: 7+ years in a senior operating, project management, chief of staff, or executive business-partner role 



• Industry background: Experience directly supporting C-suite or founder-level executives in a fast-moving business environment; healthcare/compliance exposure a plus, not required 



• Technical skills: Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, calendar management tools, project/task tracking software, and comfort working with AI-based meeting and transcription tools 



• Education: Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent experience accepted 



• Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical, detail-level execution 



• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience interacting directly with senior leadership 



• High discretion and sound judgment handling confidential information 



• Comfortable operating with autonomy and ambiguity, driving outcomes without close supervision 



• Highly diligent and precise in documentation and follow-through, with clear written and verbal communication of decisions and outcomes 



• Anticipatory mindset — proactively thinks ahead of what leadership needs and drives items forward rather than waiting to be directed 



Nice-To-Have:

• Prior experience in a Chief of Staff role at a growing or founder-led company 



• Familiarity with AI-driven operating tools and workflow automation 



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary starts at: $18/hr (commensurate of experience)

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

This is a full-time role and you will be working as part of a talented and supportive team. You will be involved in managing day to day communications with our clients, providing front line support and assistance, assigning tasks to the development team, identifying potential upsell opportunities and in general, providing a friendly, dynamic, responsive and helpful face to our existing clients. 

You will be working with our project management team, our sales team and with our web design and web development team to help drive continuous improvement within the company. 



Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities



Client Support:

- We use the SugarCRM ticketing system which supports our global web teams. The successful candidate for this role will need to play a key role in helping to manage and refine the Sugar ticketing system and be a contact point internally for any issues, training, and general support requests related to the system.

- Maintain, manage and monitor all client support requests that come in - via phone or
 - for updates, changes, questions on their website and/or our services etc.

- Ensure all support requests are responded to and actioned in a timely manner. 

- While most support requests will be assigned to the development team to complete, you will be required to monitor that these are being actioned as expected, provide clients with updates or additional information requests, as needed. 

- Maintain and monitor requests using Sugar Serve (the Group ticketing system) where support requests are logged and tracked. Our website clients purchase support hours against which site updates and changes are made, these need to not only be kept up to date, but when running low, a client will need to be contacted to request that additional hours are purchased.

- Be able to provide individual reports to clients who request to see a log of all site updates and changes over a given period. 

- Proactively contact clients ahead of financial announcements or other key dates in order to manage site updates in advance. 

- Note that while the role is full time and normal office hours, there will be times when a client request requires an early morning, evening or weekend activity. This is typically managed and agreed in advance but this role does require some flexibility around working hours.



Person Specification



The successful candidate will demonstrate the following core strengths:

- Native-like English speaker

- Excellent verbal and written skills 

- Ability to multi-task and prioritise in a deadline driven environment 

- Excellent task management and organizational skills

- Dynamic, self motivated and proactive, able to work quickly and accurately

- Some understanding of the stock market, investor relations tools and investor communities would be beneficial

In return we offer a competitive salary in a central location, a professional environment, flexible working hours and the opportunity to learn about the financial markets and the companies that operate within them.

You will work in an established but innovative organisation and get to be part of a fast-growing company which offers a challenge and a great opportunity to develop your skills.

title: Paid Ads & Creative Specialist (VA)
description:
About Us

YASSAS Group runs Melbourne's top-rated halal Greek restaurants — currently five venues (Southbank, Craigieburn, Docklands, Eastland, South Morang) with Mitcham opening soon. We serve authentic Greek food and drive bookings through OpenTable, direct web, and increasingly through paid Google and Meta ads.



We're growing fast and need a hands-on paid ads specialist to own our digital advertising end-to-end.



The Role

You'll be the person responsible for turning our monthly ad spend into restaurant bookings. Not vanity metrics. Not impressions. Not "brand awareness." Bookings.



You'll work remotely with full autonomy over campaign strategy, creative direction, testing, and reporting. Direct access to the owner. No layers, no politics — decisions get made and executed.



Key Responsibilities

Campaign management

Build, launch and optimise Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta Ads 
, Instagram) across all venues

Manage monthly budget across venues, campaigns and audience segments

Continuous optimisation — bid adjustments, audience refinement, keyword management, negative keywords, exclusions

Set up and maintain conversion tracking, pixels, and attribution correctly (Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API)

Creative development

Ideate, brief and produce ad creatives (images, video, copy) from our brand assets

Test multiple creative angles — food photography, testimonials, offers, events, Greek family occasions

Adapt creatives per venue, audience segment and campaign objective

Work within brand guidelines (fonts, colours, tone of voice)

Testing & optimisation

Structured A/B testing on creatives, audiences, offers, and landing pages

Weekly performance reviews and adjustments

Kill underperforming campaigns fast; scale winners

Test new ad formats, placements and audience types as platforms evolve

Analysis & reporting

Weekly report to the owner: spend, cost per booking, revenue attribution, ROAS per venue

Monthly deep-dive: what worked, what didn't, next month's plan

Attribute conversions correctly across GA4, Meta Ads Manager, and OpenTable bookings

Who You Are

Must have

Minimum 2 years hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads (please don't apply if you're a "strategy person only" — this is an execution role)

Proven track record of driving bookings, leads or sales — not just impressions. Bring the numbers.

Fluent English (written and spoken) — daily communication is in English

Ability to work independently and manage your own schedule

Strong analytical mindset — comfortable with ROAS, CPA, attribution, funnels

Basic-to-intermediate design skills (Canva, Photoshop or similar)

Nice to have

Prior experience with hospitality, restaurants, or booking-driven businesses

Video editing (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)

Experience with OpenTable, Square, or restaurant booking platforms

Familiarity with landing page tools (Unbounce, Instapage, WordPress)

Understanding of Meta dynamic ads / catalogue setup

Basic SEO understanding (as a bonus, not core)

Tools You'll Use

Google Ads Manager · Meta Business Suite · Google Analytics 4 · Google Tag Manager · Canva · OpenTable (reporting) · Slack / WhatsApp for daily comms



What We Offer

Meaningful ownership over real ad spend and real results

Direct access to the owner — decisions made fast

Long-term engagement — we don't want project workers, we want a partner

Rate discussed with successful candidates based on experience and hours

How Your Success Will Be Measured

One primary KPI: cost per booking, delivered.



Everything else — impressions, clicks, CTR, engagement, followers — is a leading indicator. What we care about is:



How many bookings did your ads drive last week?

What did each booking cost us?

Is that cost trending down as we optimise?

Monthly review, transparent numbers, no hiding behind vanity metrics.



How to Apply

Send us:



Your CV

Portfolio / case studies — campaigns you've run with the actual numbers (spend, results, cost per conversion). Screenshots welcome; blur out client names if under NDA.

A one-paragraph description of your most successful campaign to date and specifically WHY it worked

Your rate (hourly or monthly retainer) and hours per week you can commit

A note on your timezone — we need overlap with Melbourne (AEST/AEDT) hours for daily comms

Send to: 
] with subject line: "YASSAS Ads VA — [Your Name]"



Applications close: 20.8.2026



We respond to every serious application. Shortlisted candidates will do a paid trial project (real campaign, small budget) before being offered ongoing engagement.

Review and organize raw video and audio footage

nts, and storylines



Turn raw footage into cohesive, engaging narratives

B-roll



Punch-ins and reframing



Cutaways



Graphics and text



Sound design



Transitions



Stock footage or supporting visuals when appropriate



Create strong openings that capture attention immediately

title: Appointment Setter | Full-Time, Long-Term Role with US Company
description:
This Role Is Not For Everyone. It Is For One Person.



That person wakes up with something to prove. They do not need to be managed. They are not looking for a comfortable job. They are looking for a launchpad: a team that will invest in them the same way they invest in themselves, and a role where their effort directly shapes the trajectory of a growing company.



If that is you, keep reading. Every detail below matters.



Who We Are



Nested Housing is a US-based co-hosting and short term rental company built on one non-negotiable: every person who interacts with us leaves better than when they arrived. Whether they become a client or not.



We are not a big corporate team. We are a tight group of people who care deeply about each other, the people we serve, and the long term vision we are building together. We invest in our people the way we invest in our business, because the people are the business.



You will be a founding member of a brand new department. That means real influence, direct access to leadership, and a seat you help build rather than inherit.



Why This Role Exists



Qualified prospects are coming in and not getting the attention they deserve. Leads are sitting untouched. Follow-ups are being missed. Appointments are not reaching our closing team fast enough.



You are the person who fixes that.



As our Appointment Setter, you are the first voice and the first relationship a prospect has with Nested Housing. When you perform, our closers close, the business scales, and our mission reaches more people. This role is the engine of our revenue operation. It is not small, and we will not treat it that way.



What Winning Looks Like (Your 90-Day Scorecard)



We believe you deserve to know exactly how success is measured before you apply. By the end of your first 90 days, winning means:



Speed to lead: Every new inbound lead is contacted within 5 minutes during your shift. No exceptions.

Follow-up discipline: No active lead goes more than 48 hours without a touch. Leads get 6 to 10 quality touches before they are ever marked dead.

Activity: Consistent high-volume outbound across phone, SMS,
, and DMs, producing 10 to 15 real conversations per day.

Output: Ramping from 3 to 5 qualified appointments booked per week in your first month to 8 or more per week at full speed.

Show rate: 70% or more of your booked appointments actually attend, because you own the confirmation and reminder process, not just the booking.

Insight: Outcomes are tracked in our Google Sheets and Notion pipeline, patterns are identified, and you bring findings to the team without being asked.



These are targets we will pursue together. You will get training, scripts as a starting point (not a cage), call reviews, and direct coaching from leadership. We hold a high bar and we help you clear it.



The Daily Reality



This is a full time role and your only job. We are not your side hustle and you are not ours.



Your active window is 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, which is a night shift in the Philippines. During that window you are responsive and working the pipeline: live outbound calls, SMS,
, and social DMs, vetting and qualifying leads, booking appointments for our closers, updating the pipeline in real time, and joining team calls and accountability sessions. You submit an end-of-day and end-of-week report, every time. You are welcome to work additional hours beyond the core window if you want to push your numbers and your bonuses further.



There is no version of this role where you coast. There is a version where you grow faster than you thought possible.



Where This Goes



We promote from within, and the path is real: Setter ? Lead Setter ? Closer ? Acquisitions Manager.



Because you are joining a new department at the ground floor, the people who master this seat will be the ones leading it as we scale. The culture, relationships, and skills you build here will shape who you become, not just what you earn.



Who This Is Actually For



You do not need years of appointment setting experience. You do need all of the following:



You are fluent in English, spoken and written, and confident on live phone calls with US prospects.

You have a long term vision for yourself and you are actively working toward it.

You hold yourself accountable before anyone else has to. When something goes wrong, you look inward first.

You are deeply coachable. Not because you are passive, but because you understand that learning faster is how you win.

You thrive on a team and genuinely want the people around you to succeed.

You are honest even when the truth is uncomfortable, and you would never sell someone on something you do not believe will help them.

You read entire job descriptions. To confirm you did, include the phrase "I build, I grow" somewhere in your application.



This is not for you if you need flexibility around other commitments, you externalize blame when results are not there, or your words and actions do not match. We say that with respect for your time and ours.



Technical Requirements

Reliable computer (at least 8GB RAM recommended)

Stable primary internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, plus a backup connection or plan for outages

Noise-canceling headset and a quiet, professional workspace for live calls

Comfortable working in Google Sheets and Notion (or ready to learn fast)



How to Apply



Apply here: tally.so/r/NpExWQ



We review applications daily and move fast with the right people. If you have read this far and felt something, that is your signal.

Bookkeeping skills

Great ability to focus

Concerned about doing things the right way

Calm under pressure

Learning based

title: UGC & INFLUENCER COORDINATOR
description:

**Location:** Work From Home

**Hours:** 40 hours per week

**Reports To:** Creative Strategist

**Salary:** TBD



## ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a **UGC & Influencer Coordinator** to help manage our UGC creators and influencer projects for a growing ecommerce apparel brand.



Your main job is to make sure creator projects are organized, content is submitted correctly and on time, and all files and trackers are updated.



You will also help research ads, content ideas, hooks, and competitors for our Creative Strategist.



This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, responsible, good at following up, and comfortable communicating with creators.

title: Online Business Manager / Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced, highly proactive Online Business Manager (OBM) / Operations Manager to become the operational backbone of a fast-moving, founder-led personal brand and online education company.



This is not a VA or executive assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can take a vision, turn it into an executable plan, assign ownership, manage deadlines, follow up with the team, identify risks, and make sure projects actually cross the finish line — without the founder having to remember or manage every detail.



Our founder is highly creative, moves quickly, and generates a lot of ideas and opportunities. Your job is not simply to help her keep track of everything.



Your job is to build and manage an operating system so she doesn't have to.



What You'll Own



Project & Launch Management



Turn ideas, launches and initiatives into clear project plans, timelines and deliverables.

Assign tasks, owners and deadlines.

Proactively follow up with tea
mbers and contractors.

Identify bottlenecks before they become emergencies.

Manage multiple concurrent projects without losing sight of priorities.

Own final QA and ensure projects are actually complete before launch.

Run weekly team/operations meetings and keep them focused and productive.



Team Accountability



Know who owns what, what is on schedule, what is delayed and why.

Hold tea
mbers accountable without requiring the founder to intervene.

Follow up on missed deadlines and escalate appropriately.

Create clarity when ownership is ambiguous.

Help identify capacity issues and operational gaps before they become expensive.



Systems & Process



Build and improve SOPs, workflows, templates and recurring processes.

Move information out of the founder's head and into systems the team can use.

Identify repetitive work that should be delegated, templated or automated.

Maintain a reliable project-management system that the entire team actually uses.

Continuously look for ways to make the company simpler, faster and less founder-dependent.



Founder Support & Decision-Making



Protect the founder from unnecessary operational noise.

Determine what genuinely requires founder input versus what can be solved independently.

Push back when a new idea or priority threatens existing commitments.

Be comfortable saying: "Yes, we can do that — and here's what would need to move."

Bring problems with recommended solutions rather than simply escalating problems.

What We're Looking For



You are someone who gets genuine satisfaction from making a complicated business run beautifully.



You're not waiting for someone to tell you what to do next.



You naturally notice:



"Nobody owns this."



"We're going to miss this deadline."



"Why are we doing this manually?"



"This process shouldn't depend on the founder remembering it."



…and then you do something about it.



You are calm under pressure, exceptionally organized and comfortable working with highly creative people who may move faster than the systems around them.



You can zoom out and understand the priorities of the business, then zoom all the way in and notice that a link hasn't been tested before a launch.



Ideal Experience



We're especially interested in candidates with:



5+ years of experience in online business management, operations, project management, integrator, or similar roles.

Experience supporting a founder-led online business, personal brand, coaching/education company, agency, or digital-product business.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple tea
mbers and contractors.

Strong project-management experience across launches and ongoing operations.

Experience building SOPs and operational systems from scratch.

Strong understanding of automation and AI tools.

Experience with tools such as Airtable, ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Notion, Zapier or similar.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong judgment and ability to operate independently.

Comfort working with a U.S.-based team and customers.



Experience in the creator economy, coaching industry, premium/luxury brands, media, entertainment or personal-brand businesses is a plus.



This Role Is Probably NOT for You If...

You need detailed instructions before taking action.

Your primary experience is task-based virtual assistance.

You're excellent at maintaining systems but haven't built or improved them.

You avoid difficult conversations or struggle to hold people accountable.

You automatically escalate every decision to the founder.

You prefer working on one project at a time.

You consider a task complete because your portion is finished, even if the overall outcome isn't.

Fast-moving, occasionally messy entrepreneurial environments overwhelm you.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days:



Every major initiative has a clear owner, deadline and status.

Weekly tea
etings no longer need to be led by the founder.

Projects no longer depend on the founder remembering what happens next.

Missed deadlines are caught and addressed without founder intervention.

Recurring processes are documented.

The team knows exactly where to find priorities, deadlines and information.

Operational issues increasingly reach the founder as solutions and decisions, rather than problems.

The founder is spending significantly less time on project management, QA, tech coordination and chasing deliverables.



Within 6–12 months, our goal is simple:



The company should be able to execute at a high level even when the founder isn't paying attention to operations.

title: Sports Graphics Production Designer
description:
Contract: 4+ weeks, starting immediately



We make done-for-you sports graphics for colleges, schools, and clubs. We just signed several large athletic programs and are applying approved looks across full template sets before the fall season. You will work alongside our lead custom designer, producing final templates and graphics from approved designs. Strong performance can lead to an ongoing role through the season.



What You'll Do



- Apply approved master looks across template sets: swapping sports, colors, logos, text, scores, names, and photos. No designing from scratch.

- Clean photo cutouts and placement from client-submitted photos.

- Produce every template in three sizes: 1080 x 1350 (feed), 1080 x 1920 (story), 1920 x 1080 (website).

- Keep PSD files organized, layered, and named correctly for handoff.

- Deliver same day within your shift. Flag anything unclear instead of guessing.



What We Need



- Strong Photoshop production skills: fast, clean, consistent.

- Strong grammar and spelling in English. Every name and word on a graphic must be exact.

- Sharp eye for detail. Names spelled exactly as submitted, logos never stretched, nothing overlapping official marks.

- Online and responsive during the full shift, Monday through Friday. Must be able to work the 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM US Eastern window after training.

- Sports graphics experience a plus.



Schedule



- First 2 days (training): 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, working directly alongside our lead designer.

- After training: Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM US Eastern Time. You overlap with the lead designer in the early afternoon and own the late-day window.

- Minimum 4 weeks. Possibility of extension through the fall season, including paid game-day shifts.



Pay



- $5.00 USD per hour, 40 hours per week.

- Paid weekly via Wise.

title: Power BI Data & Inventory Analytics Specialist
description:
We are an established, fast-growing multi-channel e-commerce brand managing a catalog of approximately 450 active products. We partner with large-scale distributors and manage data pipelines across several retail platforms and independent web storefronts. Our business model relies on operational efficiency, data precision, and real-time capital allocation.



Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled Data Analytics & Inventory Specialist to build, optimize, and maintain an automated data pipeline using Power BI and the Microsoft Ecosystem.

Your primary mission is to consolidate data from multiple distinct sources—including daily/weekly distributor spreadsheets, multi-channel platform sales data, and advertising metrics—into a unified, clean, and highly automated decision system that guides our replenishment and tracking.



Key Responsibilities



   1. Multi-Channel Profitability Dashboards

   * Build a unified data model in Power BI aggregating data from various third-party platform exports, independent storefront datasets, and ad platform reports.

      * Standardize and map product variations across disparate channels into a single master product table to handle naming and SKU discrepancies.

      * Write DAX measures to calculate true net margins per item by accurately separating channel-specific overhead and marketing expenses.

   2. Automated Supplier Inventory Matching

   * Utilize tools like Power Automate to streamline data extraction from recurring
 data dumps, auto-saving files to OneDrive or SharePoint.

      * Build automated "Buy Alert" modules that cross-reference incoming vendor stock levels against current internal inventory deficiencies to flag purchasing opportunities.

   3. Predictive Replenishment Forecasting

   * Structure robust data-cleaning steps in Power Query to normalize varying spreadsheet layouts and messy source files without breaking the primary dashboards.

      * Develop short-term and long-term moving velocity metrics to project exact depletion timelines and automate reorder point triggers.

   4. Capital Allocation & Budget Tools

   * Design interactive parameters (such as What-If sliders) to filter procurement metrics against fixed capital limits.

      * Program ranking models that dynamically prioritize item lists based on velocity, margin performance, and advertising efficiency.

   



 Required Technical Qualifications



* Strong proficiency in Power BI Desktop & Power BI Service (DAX data modeling and dashboard layout design).

* Proficiency with Power Query for advanced data cleansing, row filtering, cell normalization, and structural formatting.

* Familiarity or experience with workflow automation tools (such as Power Automate) for automated file management and ingestion.

* Extreme Attention to Detail: Our inventory health depends entirely on exact metrics. Missing data, uncleaned cells, or structural oversight in reporting cannot occur. Precision is always prioritized over speed.

* Experience or background in the e-commerce industry or multi-channel retail logistics is a major plus (knowledge of the Amazon ecosystem is highly valued but not strictly necessary).





 Missing a qualification? Apply Anyway!

If you match most of the requirements but are missing a specific tool or niche skill on this list, please do not let that stop you from applying! We value transparency, problem-solving skills, and a strong work ethic just as much as past experience.

If you are missing a specific tool (for example, you are a Power BI expert but have never used Power Automate for
 workflows):



* Be upfront with us in your application. Tell us exactly which qualification you are missing.

* Let us know your learning plan. If you are willing and able to research, upskill, and fill in that specific knowledge gap over your first few weeks on the job, we are more than happy to give you the time and flexibility to do so.

title: Video Editor – Short-Form Ads (Uncapped Performance Bonuses (Long-Term Role)

Serious attitude, applies feedback immediately



Why Editors Love Working Here



Pay grows directly with performance, no artificial ceilings

No politics, no red tape, no unnecessary meetings

Real feedback from operators running real ad budgets

Top performers move up fast: more brands, more markets, higher pay



How to Apply



Send us:



A short intro

Your portfolio or 2-3 examples of short-form ads you have edited

Answer: What is one short-form ad you have seen recently that you thought was really well made, and why?

Your whatsapp number



We reply to every serious application. Looking forward to hearing from you.

description:

title: UGC Project Management Associate
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW:

Do you get a quiet thrill from a spreadsheet that actually matches reality?



Does it bother you — in a productive way — when a creator hasn't been followed up with, a deadline is about to slip, or a package hasn't shipped?



Are you the person who builds the tracking system before anyone asks?



Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining shaving for the modern consumer. We grow through content, and the ads our creators film are the biggest engine behind that growth.



Here's our actual problem. We send 90 to 120 creator briefs a month. About 37% of them come back on time. The rest arrive late, or need chasing, or quietly die somewhere in the middle — and every one of those started as a strategist's work that produced nothing.



We're not going to fix that with better briefs. We're going to fix it with someone who follows up.



Our Creative Sourcing & Production team is four people, and right now all four do a little of everything: finding creators, signing them, matching them to briefs, and chasing every loose end in between. The chasing is eating the work that actually grows the program.



That's the job. We're hiring a UGC Project Management Associate to catch everything that falls through the gaps — so the rest of the team can do what only they can do, and so more of those 90 to 120 briefs turn into finished ads.



This is not a creator role. You won't be on camera and you won't be writing scripts. This is an execution role, and you'll thrive here if you think in checklists, love a closed loop, and treat "I'll follow up" as a promise.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Creator Follow-Through — the bulk of the job! Track every active brief and deadline across our scripted UGC program. Send pre-due reminders before deadlines, check in the day after one slips, and send warm winback notes to creators who've gone quiet. Answer creator questions on timelines and logistics within one business day. Be the person who knows, at any 
nt, the real status of everything in flight.



Technical Support for Creators – Walk creators through submitting raw footage the right way. Catch and fix file naming problems before they reach post-production. Confirm finals and raw have both arrived before a submission counts as complete. Troubleshoot the small technical friction that quietly costs everyone days.



The Revision Loop – Our UGC program works from scripts, and what comes back doesn't always match what we asked for. Check every delivery against the approved script and flag what's missing or off-script. Relay revision requests clearly and warmly, with a specific deadline attached. Track every round to closed — nothing sits in limbo, and no round gets opened twice for the same issue.



Product, Props & Setup – Send product and props to creators, track shipments, and confirm delivery before their filming window opens. Confirm every new creator's whitelisting connection actually went through. Flag delays, address problems, and inventory gaps before they touch a creator's timeline.



Record Hygiene – If the Airtable says it, it's true. That standard starts with you. Keep statuses, dates, whitelisting access, and submission counts current within the same working session — not "later today". When a brief dies, record why. Right now most of our cancelled briefs have no reason attached, so we can't tell a bad match from a bad rate from a creator who ghosted. You'll change that. Open the tasks that hand finished footage to our post-production team, with everything they need attached.



Creator Club Support – We're launching a second program this fall (the Freebird Creator Club) where creators pitch their own ideas and edit their own work. Kenneth and our Creative Director run it. You'll handle its logistics: product, props, whitelisting, records. It's deliberately a lighter program to run and will be a small part of your week.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO

You don't write or send briefs. Kenneth does. You're copied, and you follow up.

You don't d
 which creator films which brief. 

You don't negotiate rates or terms. 

You don't give creative feedback. 



On UGC you check delivery against the script and flag what's objectively missing — but whether a performance works is the brief owner's call. On the Creator Club, creators self-edit and we never request revisions at all. Knowing which program you're in before you act is part of the job. You don't discuss creator rates. With anyone. You'll see what everyone is paid; it stays confidential, permanently.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Month 1: you know every active brief, every creator, and every deadline. The tracker is yours.

Month 3: Miguel spends zero hours chasing creators after a brief goes out. Ally isn't following up on paperwork. Kenneth stops asking "where are we on this?" because he can already see it.

Month 6: On-time delivery above 50%, from 37% today. Creators are difficult to pin down and always will be — we're not asking for perfection, we're asking for a real, sustained move.



Every pre-due reminder sent and every day-after follow-up inside 24 hours

Every creator message answered within one business day

Every revision round tracked to closed

Zero missed product or prop shipments

Every cancelled brief carries a reason, so we can finally see the pattern

An Airtable that never disagrees with reality



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Someone whose organizational instincts are almost involuntary — the kind of person who builds a tracking system before they're asked to. Relentlessly organized, and you genuinely enjoy following up. Friendly persistence is your professional superpower, not a chore. Written English that is warm, clear, and fast. Most of this role is short messages that keep people moving. You've run a deadline or approval loop with people who don't report to you — freelancers, contributors, vendors, creators. You know how to make someone want to hit your deadline. Comfortable with Asana, Airtable, Google Drive, and Sheets — or a demonstrated ability to learn operational tools quickly. Detail-oriented enough that a mismatched status in a tracker genuinely bothers you. Discreet – You'll see what every creator is paid. Calm under pressure and clear when things go sideways.



BONUS POINTS

Experience in influencer marketing, creator management, UGC production, or content operations. Background in project coordination or production coordination. Familiarity with Air for asset management. You've worked at a DTC brand or a fast-moving startup.



WHY FREEBIRD®

No politics, just execution. Join a fast-moving, high-ownership, results-driven culture. Make your mark by helping scale a 9-figure DTC brand on the verge of global breakout. Kind, people-focused team that communicates openly, collaborates well, and supports one another. We embrace growth and change, never settle, and continuously improve. We move fast, keep things simple, and innovate without fear. Remote-first and flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy and trust. Unlimited PTO. Recharge when you need to, without counting days.

title: HIGH TICKET CLOSER — US Home Services (Night Shift, Base + 10% Commission)
description:
We book the calls. You close them. Every lead is pre-qualified and expecting your call.



We're a US marketing company that fills the calendars of roofing and HVAC contractors. Our outbound team books 20 to 30 qualified calls a week with business owners who have already agreed to hear the offer. Right now the founder is taking every one of those calls himself and he has run out of hours. That's the job.



You are not cold calling. You are not prospecting. You close warm, booked appointments with business owners who know why you're calling.



What you'll actually do

Take 4 to 6 booked calls a day with US roofing and HVAC owners. Run a 20-minute consultative call: qualify, diagnose, present, close. Collect payment on the call. Log everything properly so our build team delivers what you promised. Follow up the ones who don't close first time.



What you're selling

Booked appointments with homeowners who need work done, plus the system that keeps booking them — an AI receptionist answering their calls 24/7, a new website, 60-second lead response, Google Business Profile setup. $2,500 upfront, then $297/month. Real product, real delivery team.



You must have

2+ years closing on the phone, at least one year selling to US or Western clients. A track record with $1,000+ ticket sizes — this is not appointment setting. Excellent spoken English, neutral or light accent. The confidence to talk to a 50-year-old roofing company owner like a peer, not a call centre. Ability to work 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila time — this is a night shift, and if that doesn't work for your life please don't apply. Fibre internet, quiet room, proper headset.



Pay

Base $600/month plus 10% of every dollar you collect, paid on collection. Realistic first 90 days $1,500–$2,500/month; a strong closer clears $3,000+ in our better months. Paid twice monthly, raise reviewed at 90 days.



Why this seat is good

The pipeline already exists — four full-time setters feed you, you'll never hunt. The founder closed these himself for months, so the script is proven rather than theoretical. Small team, direct access to the owner. The first closer here ends up leading the sales team.



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully. Applications without a voice recording will not be opened.



1.? ?Start your message with the word ROOFTOP.



2.? ?Send a 2-minute voice recording (Drive, Loom, Vocaroo) answering two things: the biggest deal you've closed on the phone and how you closed it — then pretend I'm a roofing owner who just said "I've tried lead companies before, they were a waste of money" and respond exactly as you would on a real call.



3.? ?Tell me your biggest ticket size, most calls handled in a day, and whether the 9 PM – 6 AM shift genuinely works long-term.



No CV needed first round. I care how you sound and how you handle the objection.

title: Marketing and Operations Manager (Right Hand) for DTC ecom Brand - $1,500+ USD Monthly
description:
Become the Right Hand to an 8-Figure Founding Team (And Build a Long-Term Future With Us)



We're an 8-figure health & wellness eCommerce brand - and we're looking for one sharp, organized person to grow with us for years.



Most job posts want a specialist. We want a mind we can trust.



Here's the truth: we can teach you everything you need to know. Marketing, media buying, copywriting, funnel building, conversion optimization - all of it. What we can't teach is how to think. How to stay organized. How to work hard and figure things out without being told twice.



So if you're smart, driven, and hungry to learn - even if you're not a marketing expert yet - keep reading. That's exactly what we're hiring for.



- The Position: Executive Assistant - Marketing & Operations (Trained Into Hands-On CMO)

- The Company: 8-figure health & wellness eCommerce brand (50% Germany, 50% USA)

- The Niche: Sleep, pain relief, and health products that genuinely change lives

- Location: 100% Remote

- Compensation: $1,500/month to start - with no ceiling, really. It goes as far as you take it.



What You'll Actually Be Doing



This is primarily a hands-on marketing role - with a heavy focus on writing. But you'll also help us build structure, sharpen processes, and grow our team as we scale. You'll be our right hand across the business.



Don't worry if some of this is new. As you learn, you'll take on more. Here's what your weeks will eventually look like:



- Writing scripts, ads, and copy using proven Direct Response principles (this is core - you must love writing)

- Optimizing conversion rates and running A/B tests that move real numbers

- Bringing structure and processes into how we run marketing

- Overseeing video editors - reviewing their work, giving revisions, keeping quality high

- Editing funnels with drag-and-drop tools

- Media buying across Meta & Google Ads

- Product testing using our internal templates

- Helping build the team as we grow



The first weeks and months have one goal: learn as much as humanly possible.



The end goal: you become a core operator we rely on completely.



Why This Role Is Different



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone to invest in - and build with for the long haul.



You'll be personally trained by us - an 8-figure founding team - in the exact skills that build wealth in this industry:



- Copywriting (Scripts, Advertorials, VSLs, Native Ads)

- Media Buying (Meta & Google Ads)

- Video Editing (Understanding what makes creatives convert)

- Product Testing (Using our proven internal templates)

- Funnel Building (Drag-and-drop web design)

- CVR Optimization (A/B testing and beyond)



This is a paid education worth more than any MBA. You don't need to walk in knowing all of this - you need to be the kind of person who can learn it fast.



Who We're Actually Looking For



Read this carefully, because it matters far more than your résumé:



- You're genuinely smart. You learn fast and connect dots others miss. This is the #1 thing we care about.

- You're a strong writer. Your English is flawless, and you genuinely enjoy writing. Non-negotiable.

- You're organized. You bring order to chaos. Systems and processes come naturally to you.

- You work hard. Not "I show up" hard - "I obsess over getting it right" hard.

- You're independent. You don't wait to be told what to do. You find the work and do it.

- You're loyal. You want to grow WITH a company. We have huge plans for the next few years, and we want someone who wants to be part of that story.



We've hired brilliant people from all kinds of backgrounds. What matters most is that you're sharp, driven, and already know your way around the eCommerce or online marketing world.



If you need hand-holding, this isn't for you. If you want to plant roots and build something real, keep reading.



Minimum Requirements

- You've worked at an online marketing agency OR an eCommerce brand. This is a must - you already understand how this world works. (Whatever your exact role was - marketing, ops, organization, assistant - we're open.)

- Fluent, exceptional English - you write clearly and persuasively

Comfortable with tools like Shopify, Canva, and social media (you don't need to be an expert - just comfortable and quick to learn)

- You use AI daily (Claude / ChatGPT) - not occasionally

- Fluent with modern tools (Slack, Notion, and whatever's new)

- Notice what's NOT here: years of deep marketing experience. That's what we'll teach you. We care far more about raw intelligence and work ethic than a perfect track record.



Why This Changes Your Life



For the right person, this isn't a job. It's a partnership. You start at $1,500/month, but for hard workers who prove themselves, there's no ceiling. As we grow, you grow. As the brand grows into a portfolio, so does your role - and your income.



We're looking for ONE person. A long-term partner. Someone we can pour knowledge into and build the next chapter with.



How to Apply



Keep it short and to the point. We only want three things:



1.) Your background: Did you work at an online marketing agency or an eCommerce brand? Tell us your role and what you actually accomplished.



2.) Largest team: What's the biggest team you've managed or coordinated?



3.) Motivation: What makes you want THIS role, long-term?



No long essays. Just the essentials, clearly written.



We read every application personally. Show us you're the one.



Application tip: Show, don't tell. Specific examples beat generic statements.



We're hiring ONE person for a long-term partnership. Quality applications only

title: Senior Accountant — NetSuite / Multi-Entity
description:
Senior Accountant with multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience in a multi-entity environment, joining an established accounting team at an energy industry company. Immediate-start contract, 2–3 months, extension possible. Remote, full-time, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific.





Summary

Senior Accountant — NetSuite, Multi-Entity Contract (2–3 months, extension possible) · Remote · Full-time, US Pacific hours · Immediate start



Bridged Financial Solutions is a fully remote US accounting, tax, and fractional CFO firm. We are staffing a Senior Accountant for a client in the energy industry that runs NetSuite across a multi-entity structure.



The client has an established accounting department of roughly eight onshore staff. This role is additional capacity alongside that team — you will be working within their existing close process, standards, and review structure rather than building or running your own.



This is a hands-on production seat. You will be in NetSuite every day.



Scope

The exact task mix is being finalized as we determine which work moves to this role. It will draw from across the close cycle rather than sitting in one corner of the system, so what matters is that you can be handed any core piece of NetSuite.



You should have working command of, at minimum:



General ledger — journal entries, recurring and memorized entries, accruals, prepaids, allocation schedules

Period close — Period Close Checklist, A/P and A/R sub-period locking versus GL close, post-close corrections

Accounts payable — vendor bills, bill credits, payment runs, vendor records

Accounts receivable — invoicing, customer payments, credit memos, aging and collections

Banking and reconciliation — bank feeds and statement imports, account reconciliation, deposits, undeposited funds

Multi-subsidiary and consolidation — subsidiary hierarchy, intercompany transactions, eliminations, consolidated reporting

Segmentation — subsidiary, class, department, location, and custom segments, and when each should be used

Fixed assets — asset records, depreciation schedules, disposals

Reporting — standard financials, report customization, and saved searches (criteria, results, and formula fields)

System fundamentals — roles and permissions, audit trail and system notes, record hierarchy



Beyond the mechanics, we expect you to reconcile what you touch, document your workpapers so they stand on their own, and raise misclassifications, duplicates, and control gaps when you find them rather than booking around them.



Requirements

Multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience as a preparer — not a report consumer

Genuine multi-entity experience: multiple subsidiaries, intercompany activity, consolidated reporting

Strong month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation discipline

Advanced Excel at a workpaper-building level — pivots, lookups, clean tie-outs

Comfortable working in the Microsoft 365 environment — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint / OneDrive

Able to work effectively inside an established team: take direction, follow existing conventions, and communicate status without being chased

Written English strong enough to document your own work and escalate an issue clearly

Availability for the full US Pacific business day, Monday through Friday

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, a backup connection and power plan, and a private workspace



Nice to have

BS Accountancy; CPA or CPA candidate

Experience in energy, utilities, power generation, or another capital-intensive industry

Project or job costing experience

Prior experience supporting a US-based accounting department



Details

Independent contractor engaged directly by Bridged Financial Solutions

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

Initial term of 2–3 months with an immediate start; extension possible

Compensation: competitive, depending on experience

You provide your own equipment; we provide all software access

NDA and background check required before any client data access





Three to five sentences on the largest multi-entity NetSuite environment you have worked in — number of subsidiaries, currencies, and what you personally owned in the close

Your expected hourly rate (USD) and earliest start date



Applications missing #2 will not be reviewed.



B. Screening questions

Questions

1) What NetSuite role did you hold (Accountant / Controller / Administrator / custom)? Could you post journal entries and close periods yourself?

Separates preparers from people who ran reports out of someone else's instance.

2) In the largest environment you worked in: how many subsidiaries, how many currencies, and was it NetSuite OneWorld?

The single highest-value filter. A meaningful share of applicants describe several separate QuickBooks files as "multi-entity."

3) Can you commit to 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday, for the next three months? What other engagements would you be working around?

Moonlighting on top of an existing full-time job is the most common failure mode on contract hires.

4) Which of the following have you personally worked in: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, fixed assets, intercompany/eliminations, saved searches?

Breadth check, since the scope isn't fixed. Gaps aren't automatically disqualifying — clustering in only one or two is.

5) Describe the accounting team you last worked in. How many people, and where did your work go for review?

This role slots into an eight-person department. You want someone used to a review chain, not a sole-charge operator.

6) What is your internet speed, and what is your backup for outages?

7) Expected hourly rate in USD?





Technical screen 

1. "Walk me through your month-end close in NetSuite, day one to sign-off."



2. "How does NetSuite handle intercompany? Take one transaction from origination through elimination." 



3. "What's the difference between closing a period and locking a period? What do you do when a correction is needed after close?"



4. "Describe a saved search you built and why a standard report wouldn't do it.



5. "Tell me about a balance sheet account that wouldn't reconcile. How did you find the break?" 



6. "How do you d
 whether something should be tracked by class, department, location, or a custom segment?" 



7. "You're new to a team that already has its own way of doing things, and you think one of their reconciliation schedules is wrong. What do you do?"

To succeed in this role, the assistant must align with five core principles. First, you must protect the CEO's time by filtering all inbound requests and prioritizing what is truly important. Second, calendar efficiency is paramount; you must be clear, committed, and always include context. Third, every correspondence should be answered clearly and kindly, showing appreciation for the response whether it is a 'yes' or a polite decline. Fourth, you must "Design the Play" by being preemptive and coming prepared for all moving pieces. Finally, prioritizing revenue is essential—tasks should be ordered based on what will generate the biggest outcome, as making or saving money is the ultimate priority.



Key Responsibilities



Communication Management



Managing the CEO's communications is a critical daily function. You will process the CEO's inbox twice daily, aiming for Inbox Zero by 10 AM EST and 5 PM EST. This involves filtering inbound requests, tagging
s into the appropriate categories (Personal, Sales & External, Internal, Hiring, Legal, Travel, Events, and Financial), and responding on the CEO's behalf using established templates. A strict one-day turnaround is expected for initial
 responses, resolutions, online orders, and payment notifications. You will also send end-of-day updates to keep the CEO informed of any unaddressed items.



Business Operations & Task Management



You will be responsible for ensuring that key business tasks are completed on time and nothing falls through the cracks. This includes tracking and following up on agreements, contracts, and legal documents to ensure they are signed and executed promptly. You will maintain a daily to-do list, manage action items fro
etings, and coordinate with internal tea
mbers and external contacts on the CEO's behalf. Staying informed about key business projects and deadlines is essential so you can proactively flag issues and keep the CEO updated.



Personal & Lifestyle Support



You will handle a range of personal tasks to ensure the CEO maintains a balanced and well-supported lifestyle.



Responsibility Area

Details & Preferences

Nutrition

Order daily lunch and dinner, selecting natural food options (e.g., Pura Vida, Just Salad) with simple ingredients (chicken, steak, broccoli, eggs) while avoiding seed and vegetable oils.

Household Management

Coordinate cleaners twice a week for apartment cleaning, laundry, and ironing, utilizing local services like the NOON app when the CEO is in Dubai.

Financial Monitoring

Handle company and personal purchases, manage gifting for clients, friends, and family, and monitor expenses and budgets related to the CEO's activities.









Requirements



The successful candidate will have proven experience as a Personal Assistant or Executive Assistant supporting C-level executives. Exceptional organizational and time-management skills are required, along with strong written and verbal communication abilities to draft professional correspondence and confidently respond on behalf of the CEO. You must be highly proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs) and comfortable managing sensitive documents, agreements, and financial information. Above all, you must be a proactive problem-solver who handles sensitive information with the utmost discretion and anticipates issues before they arise.



Compensation



This role offers a base salary of $800 USD per month, with on-target earnings (OTE) ranging from $1,000 to $1,200 USD per month inclusive of performance-based incentives.

description:
Run Our Automated YouTube Video Workflow (Long-Term)



We run a fast-growing YouTube channel management company. Our videos are largely generated by our own automation tool, we're looking for a reliable VA to operate that workflow from start to finish: input ? generate ? polish ? publish.



How the workflow works:



Input — You receive the topic and materials for each video and fill in the required info in our tool

Generate — The tool automatically creates the full video for you

Edit — You do a light final edit: the videos are slideshow-style (images placed in sequence), so this is quick and simple — no advanced editing skills needed. You check that everything flows well, fix anything that looks off, and make sure the output is clean

Publish — You upload the finished video to the right YouTube channel, add the title, description, and thumbnail, and schedule it according to our publishing calendar



You'll be running this workflow across multiple channels on a fixed weekly schedule.



What you'll be responsible for:



Producing and publishing videos end-to-end using our tool

Making sure every video meets our quality bar before it goes live

Publishing the right video to the right channel, on time, every time

Keeping our tracker updated so the team always knows the status of each video

Flagging issues early (tool errors, missing materials) instead of letting deadlines slip



What we're looking for:



Comfortable learning new software quickly, we'll train you on our tool with full documentation and examples

Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or similar). The editing is simple, but your eye for detail matters

Experience with YouTube Studio (uploading, scheduling, metadata) is a big plus

Extremely reliable, our channels run on a fixed publishing schedule and consistency is everything

Organized: you'll manage multiple channels at once without mixing things up

Daily communication in English via WhatsApp/Slack



What we offer:



A long-term role with growing volume — we onboard new channels every month, so your workload (and income) grows with us

Full training, templates, and step-by-step documentation, you're never guessing

A simple, repeatable workflow: once you know it, you can move fast

Flexible hours, as long as the publishing schedule is met





How to apply:

Send us:



A short intro about yourself and your experience with video editing and/or YouTube

1–2 examples of videos you've worked on (slideshow-style is a plus, not required)

Your rate (per video or per month)



Start your application with the word "FREQUENCY" so we know you've actually read this post. Applications without it will be ignored.

title: Amazon Account Manager | Client-Facing | PPC + Catalog Management
description:
Amazon Account Manager | Client-Facing | PPC + Catalog Management

Peak ROAS | Remote | Full-Time



ABOUT PEAK ROAS



Peak ROAS is a full-service Amazon growth agency helping established brands improve profitability and performance across the Amazon marketplace.



We manage more than advertising. Our team works across Amazon PPC, catalog management, listing optimization, promotions, inventory strategy, and overall marketplace growth.



We are a systems-driven company that uses proprietary software, automation, and AI to help our team work more efficiently and make better decisions.



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager who combines strong hands-on Amazon expertise with excellent client communication.



THE ROLE



This is a client-facing and hands-on Amazon management position.



You will help manage the day-to-day performance of multiple Amazon accounts while serving as a primary point of contact for your assigned clients.



You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. business owners, executives, and eCommerce teams through video calls,
, and chat.



You will be expected to understand what is happening within each account, identify opportunities and problems, recommend actions, and clearly explain the strategy to the client.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes tasks behind the scenes. We want someone who can take ownership of an Amazon account and confidently communicate with the client about it.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS



* 3+ years of hands-on Amazon account management experience

* Strong direct Amazon PPC management experience

* Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts simultaneously

* Strong knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

* Hands-on experience using Amazon Ads bulk files

* Strong Amazon catalog and listing management experience

* Experience with parent/child variations and category flat files

* Strong Google Sheets and/or Excel skills

* Strong practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Comfortable leading professional client video calls in English

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail

* Able to work independently, solve problems, and take ownership of results



Amazon agency experience managing multiple client accounts is strongly preferred.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



CLIENT & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT



* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned Peak ROAS clients

* Lead regular client video calls and performance discussions

* Explain performance, challenges, opportunities, strategy, and next steps clearly

* Respond professionally and promptly to client
s and messages

* Proactively communicate problems rather than waiting for clients to discover them

* Track client requests and ensure commitments are completed

* Manage expectations and build strong client relationships through competence and follow-through



AMAZON ADVERTISING | APPROXIMATELY 50%



Manage Amazon PPC across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display, including:



* Campaign structure and optimization

* Bids, targeting, search terms, and negative keywords

* Search-term harvesting and target promotion

* Budgets and placements

* Amazon Ads bulk files

* ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CVR, and other performance metrics

* Advertising strategy based on inventory, promotions, ranking goals, and business objectives



You will also work within Peak ROAS proprietary campaign management tools and automations.



CATALOG & LISTING MANAGEMENT | APPROXIMATELY 40%



* Manage parent/child variation structures

* Work with Amazon category flat files

* Resolve suppressed, inactive, stranded, or incorrectly configured listings

* Work with Seller Support to resolve catalog issues

* Optimize titles, bullets, backend search terms, and listing attributes

* Identify conversion opportunities

* Coordinate listing copy and creative recommendations

* Troubleshoot catalog issues affecting advertising or sales



DEALS, PROMOTIONS & INVENTORY | APPROXIMATELY 10%



* Coordinate Amazon deals, coupons, and promotions

* Align promotions with advertising strategy

* Monitor inventory levels and days of supply

* Identify potential stockout risks

* Adjust advertising strategy based on inventory availability

* Communicate inventory concerns and recommendations to clients



AI, AUTOMATION & SYSTEMS



AI should already be part of how you work, not something you are just beginning to learn.



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI platforms to improve:



* Data and search-term analysis

* Keyword classification

* Listing optimization

* Research

* Spreadsheet work

* Problem solving

* Client communication preparation

* Workflow efficiency



You must also understand that AI output needs to be reviewed and validated before it is implemented.



Peak ROAS has developed internal automations and SaaS tools to improve campaign management and account analysis. You must be comfortable learning and working within structured systems and processes.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Understand Amazon deeply enough to explain why something is happening, not simply report numbers

* Are comfortable taking ownership of client relationships

* Communicate problems proactively

* Can confidently discuss both positive and negative performance with clients

* Think analytically and solve problems independently

* Can move comfortably between PPC, catalog, listings, promotions, and inventory

* Use systems, automation, and AI to make yourself more effective

* Follow established processes while identifying opportunities to improve them

* Take accountability for your work and follow through on commitments



Strong Amazon technical skills without strong client communication skills will not be sufficient for this position.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be consistently available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time for client communication, internal collaboration,
, chat, and video meetings.



For candidates located in the Philippines, please understand that this is an overnight work schedule.



COMPENSATION



Compensation will depend on your experience, Amazon expertise, and demonstrated ability to independently manage client relationships.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position with the opportunity to grow into greater account ownership and responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words: PEAK CLIENT MANAGER



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked directly managing Amazon accounts?



2. What is the largest number of Amazon accounts you have managed at the same time?



3. Briefly describe your experience with Amazon PPC bulk files.



4. Briefly describe one difficult Amazon catalog or listing problem you personally solved.



5. What AI tools do you currently use, and how do you use them in your Amazon work?



6. Include a link to a 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and briefly explaining your Amazon experience as if you were speaking to a client.



Please use at least 10 Apply Points when applying.



Applicants who do not begin their application with “PEAK CLIENT MANAGER,” answer all six questions, and use at least 10 Apply Points will not be considered.
